article-title.#text: IoT 센서기반의 인공지능 기술이 융합된 김치 냉장고의 미래
IoT 센서기반의 인공지능 기술이 융합된 김치 냉장고의 미래

abstract.#text:
Kimchi is a living-food that continues to undergo changes during production and distribution. To maintain its quality, various methods are being considered, although high salt treatment or irradiation can lead to quality deterioration. The optimal storage method for kimchi involves aging, followed by cold storage and requiring sealing to minimize exposure to external air. Given the contemporary context and the love of Koreans for kimchi, a unique type of refrigerator known as the kimchi refrigerator has been developed based on research data on aging and storage over time. However, there are limitations to providing optimal aging and storage for all types of kimchi. To address such limitations, a solution is proposed to apply artificial intelligence and IoT technology to kimchi refrigerators to recognize the types and conditions of kimchi and provide the optimal storage environment.
This integration technology is expected to enhance the consumer quality of various types of kimchi.

article-title.#text: 韓國の人工知能基本法の主要內容
한국의 인공지능기본법의 주요내용
Main Contents of Korea's AI Framework Act

abstract.#text: 韓国の人工知能基本法は、 人工知能の健全な発展と信頼基盤の造成に必要な基本的な事項を規定する ことにより、 国民の権益と尊厳性を保護し、 国民の生活の質の向上と国家競争力を強化するのに資する ことを目的とする。 人工知能基本法の制定により、 人工知能事業者に対する規制体系が本格的に樹立･運 営されている。 特に人工知能基本法には、 人工知能の安全性･透明性などに関連する義務および高影響人 工知能に対する規制など、 人工知能事業者に直接的な義務を課す内容が含まれており、 義務違反時に過 怠料処分を受けることになる。 また、 国内代理人指定制度の導入で海外人工知能事業者に対しても厳し い規制が適用されるものと見込まれる。 続いて施行令草案も発表され、 まもなくガイドラインも出る予 定だ。 人工知能基本法を制定し、 関連業界では様々な評価が存在する。 政府レベルの人工知能技術及び産業 振興のための法的根拠が設けられ、 今後の投資が活発に行われるという肯定的な評価があるかとすれ ば、 一部では人工知能基本法上の規制内容が曖昧であるという点で依然として事業環境に不確実性が存 在するという懸念も提起される。 人工知能基本法は、 韓国の人工知能成長の可能性を損なうことなく発展した外国の人工知能技術を基 盤とするデジタル機器およびアルゴリズムから国民の安全を守り、 人権を保護することを優先にしな ければならない。

The purpose of the AI Framework Act(Framework Act on the Development of Artificial Intelligence and Establishment of Trust) is to protect human rights and dignity, and to contribute to enhance the quality of life, while strengthening national competitiveness by establishing essential regulations for the sound development of artificial intelligence (ai) and the establishment of trust.
With the enactment of the AI Framework Act a regulatory system for artificial intelligence operators is being established and operated in earnest. In particular, the AI Framework Act includes imposing direct obligations on artificial intelligence operators, such as obligations related to the safety and transparency of artificial intelligence and regulations on high-impact artificial intelligence, so violations of obligations will be subject to fines. In addition, with the introduction of the domestic agent designation system, strict regulations are expected to be applied to overseas artificial intelligence operators. Subsequently, a draft enforcement decree will be announced and guidelines will be released soon.
There are various evaluations in related industries over the enactment of the AI Framework Act. While there is a positive assessment that investment will be actively made in the future due to the establishment of a legal basis for the promotion of artificial intelligence technology and industry at the government level, some raise concerns that there is still uncertainty in the business environment due to ambiguous regulations under the AI Framework Act.
The AI Framework Act should make it a priority to protect the safety of the people and protect human rights from digital devices and algorithms based on foreign artificial intelligence technology that have developed without damaging Korea's artificial intelligence growth potential. Therefore, it is necessary to promote business activities while minimizing industrial damage in legal management, minimizing corporate burden, clarifying intervention requirements for business activities, and activating administrative monitoring and rapid intervention.

article-title.#text: 中韩人工智能全球治理研究 – 以美国的人工智能战略为中心 –
한중 인공지능 글로벌 거버넌스 연구 - 미국 인공지능 전략을 중심으로 -
Research on Global Governance of Artificial Intelligence in China and South Korea- Centered on the United States’ Artificial Intelligence Strategy -

abstract.#text: 本文以美国特朗普政府及拜登政府在人工智能领域的战略为中心, 探讨中国与韩国参 与人工智能全球治理的路径及倡议诉求。 美国的特朗普政府及拜登政府都强调美国要取得人工智能领域的领导人地位, 且为了 取得领导地位, 都会加强与美国同盟国的合作。拜登政府趋向于加强监管人工智能, 特朗 普政府取消对美国科技公司的监管, 促进科技竞争。 中国与韩国都都支持联合国框架下展开人工智能全球治理建设, 且都有本国参与主导 的人工智能全球治理机制。韩国发挥中轴国家外交, 通过与欧洲国家的双边合作, 举办了 人工智能安全峰会, 并举办人工智能在军事领域的治理会议。 中韩两国虽然都制定了人工智能全球治理倡议, 但都未签署对方的倡议文件。两国目 前没有相关对话机制。但在第三方合作层面有交集。

This article focuses on the strategies of the Trump and Biden administrations in the field of artificial intelligence, exploring the paths and advocacy demands for China and South Korea to participate in global governance of artificial intelligence.
Both the Trump and Biden administrations in the United States have emphasized the need for the United States to gain leadership in the field of artificial intelligence, and in order to do so, they will strengthen cooperation with American allies.
Both China and South Korea support the construction of global governance for artificial intelligence under the framework of the United Nations, and both have their own countries participating in and leading the global governance mechanism for artificial intelligence. South Korea has leveraged its diplomacy as a central axis country, hosting the Artificial Intelligence Security Summit and the Governance Conference on Artificial Intelligence in the Military Field through bilateral cooperation with European countries.
Although both China and South Korea have formulated global governance initiatives for artificial intelligence, they have not signed each other’s initiative documents. There is currently no relevant dialogue mechanism between the two countries. But there are intersections at the level of third-party cooperation.

article-title.#text: Theological Issues in the Age of Artificial Intelligence: Towards “AI Theology” for Mission
인공지능 시대에 제기되는 신학적 담론들: 선교를 위한 “인공지능 신학” 모색
Theological Issues in the Age of Artificial Intelligence: Towards “AI Theology” for Mission

abstract.#text: While the current development of AI remains a subject of great intrigue for many, its trajectory promises to dive deep into uncharted philosophical and theological waters. Therefore, this article examines the questions that the development of AI will pose to theology and explores how AI and theology can coexist harmoniously. Moving beyond reinterpreting existing theological areas such as creationism, anthropology, hamartiology, soteriology, and eschatology, it seeks to explore the possibilities of “AI theology” from a missiological perspective. Recalling that the 2,000-year history of Christian missions has been a sincere response to the theological questions of each era, we must persist in contemplating contemporary theological questions from a missionary perspective.

article-title.#text: Artificial Intelligence(AI), Four Quartets, and the Buddhist Ālaya-vijñāna
인공지능, 네 사중주, 불교의 아뢰야식
Artificial Intelligence(AI), Four Quartets, and the Buddhist Ālaya-vijñāna

abstract.#text: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence(AI) has reshaped contemporary life and intensified philosophical questions concerning human consciousness and selfhood. While AI systems increasingly simulate cognitive and creative processes, they remain confined to surface-level cognition and instrumental reasoning. This paper argues that the AI era calls for a renewed inquiry into deeper dimensions of human consciousness that transcend computational intelligence. Through a comparative analysis of T. S. Eliot’s Four Quartets and Buddhist Yogācāra philosophy, this study examines the distinction between ego-centered awareness and a deeper, non-dual consciousness. Eliot’s concept of the “still point of the turning world” articulates an experience of ultimate reality that transcends temporal flux, desire, and phenomenal distraction. This poetic vision parallels Yogācāra’s distinction between discriminative consciousness and ālaya-vijñāna, the storehouse or deep consciousness that underlies all experience. By bringing Eliot’s spiritual poetics into dialogue with Buddhist philosophy, this paper proposes an alternative model of human identity for the age of AI—one grounded not in technological mastery, but in awakening to the deeper mind as the source of authentic fulfillment and existential integration.

article-title.#text: Clinical Application of Artificial Intelligence in Breast MRI
유방 MRI에서 인공지능의 임상적 활용
Clinical Application of Artificial Intelligence in Breast MRI

author.#text: Su Min Ha(Department of Radiology, Seoul National University Hospital, Seoul, Korea)

abstract.#text: Breast MRI is the most sensitive imaging modality for detecting breast cancer. However, its widespread use is limited by factors such as extended examination times, need for contrast agents, and susceptibility to motion artifacts. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a promising solution for these challenges by enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of breast MRI in multiple domains. AI-driven image reconstruction techniques have significantly reduced scan times while preserving image quality. This method outperforms traditional parallel imaging and compressed sensing. AI has also shown great promise for lesion classification and segmentation, with convolutional neural networks and U-Net architectures improving the differentiation between benign and malignant lesions. AI-based segmentation methods enable accurate tumor detection and characterization, thereby aiding personalized treatment planning. An AI triaging system has demonstrated the potential to streamline workflow efficiency by identifying low-suspicion cases and reducing the workload of radiologists. Another promising application is synthetic breast MR image generation, which aims to generate contrast enhanced images from non-contrast sequences, thereby improving accessibility and patient safety. Further research is required to validate AI models across diverse populations and imaging protocols. As AI continues to evolve, it is expected to play an important role in the optimization of breast MRI.

article-title.#text: 人工智能时代阅读新未来
인공지능 시대의 새로운 미래를 독서하자
Let's read the new future of the AI era

abstract.#text: 阅读是每个人从自然生命成长为精神个体的关键环节，也是人类文 明生成延续的主要途径。随着人工智能技术的发展，全民阅读行业也在 积极应用人工智能算法技术，基于用户画像，进入个性化智能化推荐新 时代。在通用人工智能、元宇宙与脑机接口等新技术大发展的今天，阅 读也面临全新的形式、内容和定义，但阅读的本质仍然不变，这就是让 人成为更好的自己。

article-title.#text: Clinical Application of Artificial Intelligence in Breast Ultrasound
유방초음파에서 인공지능의 임상적 활용
Clinical Application of Artificial Intelligence in Breast Ultrasound

author.#text: Hye Jung Kim(Department of Radiology, School of Medicine, Kyungpook National University, Kyungpook National University Chilgok Hospital, Daegu, Korea)
Jung Hyun Yoon(Department of Radiology, Severance Hospital, Research Institute of Radiological Science, Yonsei University College of Medicine, Seoul, Korea)

Won Hwa Kim(BeamWorks Inc., Daegu, Korea)

abstract.#text:
Breast cancer is the most common cancer in women worldwide, and its early detection is critical for improving survival outcomes. As a diagnostic and screening tool, mammography can be less effective owing to the masking effect of fibroglandular tissue, but breast US has good sensitivity even in dense breasts. However, breast US is highly operator dependent, highlighting the need for artificial intelligence (AI)-driven solutions. Unlike other modalities, US is performed using a handheld device that produces a continuous real-time video stream, yielding 12000–48000 frames per examination. This can be significantly challenging for AI development and requires real-time AI inference capabilities. In this review, we classified AI solutions as computer-aided diagnosis and computer-aided detection to facilitate a functional understanding and review commercial software supported by clinical evidence.
In addition, to bridge healthcare gaps and enhance patient outcomes in geographically under resourced areas, we propose a novel framework by reviewing the existing AI-based triage workflows including mobile ultrasound.

article-title.#text: 医疗人工智能算法的法律规制识别
의료인공지능 알고리즘의 법적 규제 식별
Legal identification of medical artificial intelligence algorithm

author.#text: 袁梓旋(中国政法大学 民商经济法学院)

abstract.#text: 医疗人工智能算法应用过程中存在诊疗活动自主性受限、诊疗过程透明性匮乏、医疗算法偏见性诱导以及安全性缺失风险。在风险防治过程中出现了传统监管缺陷、主体资格界定模糊、算法权力控制失衡、责任主体追溯难等现实挑战，迫切需要运用法律手段予以纾解。基于对法律体系完整性和医疗应用场景的特殊性。本文对医疗人工智能算法的规制研究以算法规制为视角，基于人工智能算法发展现状，将医疗人工智能算法视为产品，对医疗人工智能的应用发展提供方向性指引。医疗人工智能最终能否实现科技向善将受到多种因素影响，法律在其中的作用集中于预防、控制或避免算法风险对患者权利，医疗人工智能算法使用时，研发设计者需要对医疗数据的规范性和医疗算法产品运行的安全性进行审查并承担侵权责任，以确保医疗算法的安全可靠。对于医疗人工智能算法风险的有效防治，需要厘清医疗人工智能算法风险防治的困境，以便精准施策。本文认为，我国医疗人工智能算法规制立法应当以患者权利保障为核心。立法应当选择在保持立法的完整性和体系性的基础上，针对算法风险，将算法规制的相关内容在已有的患者权利保障和算法规制相关的立法当中进行完善，从而促进人工智能算法在医疗领域良性发展。

In the application of medical artificial intelligence algorithm, there are risks such as limited autonomy of diagnosis and treatment activities, lack of transparency in diagnosis and treatment process, biased induction of medical algorithm and lack of security. In the process of risk prevention, there are some practical challenges, such as the defects of traditional supervision, the vague definition of subject qualification, the imbalance of algorithmic power control, and the difficulty in tracing the responsible subject, which urgently need to be relieved by legal means. Based on the integrity of the legal system and the particularity of medical application scenarios. This paper studies the regulation of medical artificial intelligence algorithm from the perspective of algorithm regulation. Based on the development status of artificial intelligence algorithm, it regards medical artificial intelligence algorithm as a product and provides directional guidance for the application and development of medical artificial intelligence. Whether the medical artificial intelligence can finally realize the improvement of science and technology will be affected by many factors. The role of law in it focuses on preventing, controlling or avoiding the algorithm risks to patients' rights. When using the medical artificial intelligence algorithm, the R&D designer needs to review the standardization of medical data and the safety of medical algorithm products and bear the tort liability to ensure the safety and reliability of medical algorithms. For the effective prevention and control of medical artificial intelligence algorithm risk, it is necessary to clarify the dilemma of medical artificial intelligence algorithm risk prevention and control in order to make accurate policies. This paper holds that the legislation of medical artificial intelligence algorithm regulation in China should focus on the protection of patients' rights. Legislation should choose to improve the relevant content of algorithm regulation in the existing legislation related to patient rights protection and algorithm regulation on the basis of maintaining the integrity and systematization of legislation, so as to promote the benign development of artificial intelligence algorithm in the medical field.

article-title.#text: Artificial intelligence in perioperative medicine: a narrative review
주술기 의학에서의 인공지능: 서술적 리뷰
Artificial intelligence in perioperative medicine: a narrative review

author: Yoon Hyun-Kyu(Department of Anesthesiology and Pain Medicine, Seoul National University Hospital)
Yang Hyun-Lim(Department of Anesthesiology and Pain Medicine, Seoul National University Hospital)

abstract.#text: Recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) techniques have enabled the development of accurate prediction models using clinical big data. AI models for perioperative risk stratification, intraoperative event prediction, biosignal analyses, and intensive care medicine have been developed in the field of perioperative medicine. Some of these models have been validated using external datasets and randomized controlled trials. Once these models are implemented in electronic health record systems or software medical devices, they could help anesthesiologists improve clinical outcomes by accurately predicting complications and suggesting optimal treatment strategies in real-time. This review provides an overview of the AI techniques used in perioperative medicine and a summary of the studies that have been published using these techniques. Understanding these techniques will aid in their appropriate application in clinical practice.

article-title.#text: Analysis of International Regulations on Artificial Intelligence(AI) Ethics – a Comparative Approach
인공지능(AI) 윤리 규범 국제적 비교 분석
Analysis of International Regulations on Artificial Intelligence(AI) Ethics – a Comparative Approach

abstract.#text: With the rapid development of AI technology, ethical issues on AI have emerged as national regulation may be too limited or ineffective to manage globally shared risks of AI within each state. This paper first analyzes the major existing AI regulations from ‘a multi-level framework, having three-layered rule-making such as global, international, and domestic. It then analyzes international AI ethics regulations under the UNESCO, the OECD, and the EU. Finally, it derives policy implications for Korea's AI ethics rule-making at both international and domestic levels, particularly concerned with policy goals of regulating AI technology with public interest for humanity. Previous literature shows that there are eight core principles overlapped while all three AI ethics regulations by the UNESCO, the OECD, and the EU contain their own policy actions to implement their principles proposed. In particular, the EU's regulation, which are in the form of guidelines, are much more advanced, while the UNESCO regulation is the one that suggested a principle related to governance framework of AI ethics which mentions 'multi-stakeholder'. Internationally, Korea needs to work together with other countries as well as IOs toward global convergence of AI ethics regulations. Domestically, Korea is recommended to take multi-stakeholder approach to build consensus as well as to make the international regulations harmonized with domestic laws.

article-title.#text: Exploring Korean University Students' Perceptions of Artificial Intelligence (AI) Education
국내 대학생의 인공지능 교육에 대한 인식 연구
Exploring Korean University Students' Perceptions of Artificial Intelligence (AI) Education

abstract.#text: In today's world, having knowledge and skills related to Artificial Intelligence (AI) is essential for diverse university students. As a result, many Korean universities offer AI-related courses as part of their mandatory curriculum. However, designing an AI curriculum that caters to university students requires considering the previous experiences and perspectives of AI convergence education. Thus, navigating the perceptions of AI convergence education among Korean university students not majoring in computers is important. To achieve this goal, an online survey was conducted during the 2023 summer from various departments at C University in Korea (n=177). Survey results indicate that Korean universities showed an awareness of the personal implications of AI concerning their academic discipline and careers. Also, they recognize the importance of AI education regardless of their current majors at the university. In addition, survey results also revealed the presence or absence of prior AI educational experiences significantly affected the perceived importance of AI convergence education. However, students without prior AI exposure could struggle to take AI courses in liberal arts because they are not well equipped and prepared to take those mandatory courses. The study has the novelty and uniqueness in that future studies will receive valuable insights for constructing AI convergence education that caters to diverse university students in higher education.

article-title.#text: Can Artificial Intelligence Be a Member of the Moral Community?
인공지능은 도덕 공동체의 일원이 될 수 있는가?
Can Artificial Intelligence Be a Member of the Moral Community?

abstract.#text: According to Kant, all rational beings are members of the moral community. If future artificial intelligence achieves or surpasses human-level intelligence, should it be considered a member of the moral community? The goal of this paper is to defend a negative answer to this question. To this end, it argues for three points. First, for AI to be a member of the moral community, moral norms must apply to it. This requires that AI possess the rational capacity to act in conformity with, or contrary to, moral norms. But AI lacks this rational capacity. Second, to include AI within the moral community, we must regard it as governed by moral norms. This requires the possibility of effective social sanctions to enforce these norms on AI. However, since AI lacks genuine self-interest, it is not possible to implement effective social sanctions that restrict or harm its self-interest, even if it acts against moral norms. Third, Sparrow proposes the so-called ‘Turing Triage Test’ to assess whether AI has the same moral status as human beings. But there are strong reasons to deny that AI would pass the Turing Triage Test.

article-title.#text: AI in Prostate MRI: A Task-Based Review
전립선 MRI에서의 인공지능: 임무에 따른 고찰
AI in Prostate MRI: A Task-Based Review

author.#text: Moon Hyung Choi(Department of Radiology, Eunpyeong St. Mary’s Hospital, College of Medicine, The Catholic University of Korea, Seoul, Korea)

abstract.#text: Prostate MRI is widely employed across the clinical pathway of prostate cancer, including detection, staging, treatment planning, and surveillance. With the increasing demand for consistent and efficient image interpretation, AI has gained considerable attention as a supportive tool in prostate MRI. This review provides a task-based overview of AI applications in prostate MRI, addressing key areas such as prostate gland segmentation, cancer detection and risk stratification, local staging, disease monitoring during active surveillance, recurrence detection, and image quality assessment. Across these tasks, AI, particularly deep learning, has demonstrated promising results. Although only a limited number of AI tools for prostate MRI are commercially available, it remains essential for radiologists to understand how AI can support clinical practice, particularly as further advances are anticipated.

article-title.#text: The Prospects of Applying Artificial Intelligence Technology in Game Development
게임 개발에서 인공지능 기술의 확장성에 관한 연구
The Prospects of Applying Artificial Intelligence Technology in Game Development

abstract.#text: The rapid advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming game development by introducing new methods for content creation, character interaction, and system automation. This study investigates the application and scalability of three representative AI technologies—Voyager, Generative Agents, and NVIDIA ACE—within modern game design. It aims to assess how these systems can address inefficiencies in traditional workflows and support the creation of more adaptive, personalized, and dynamic game experiences. Employing a qualitative approach that combines case analysis with comparative evaluation, the research examines each technology’s operational mechanism, developmental role, and design implications. Voyager enables autonomous world exploration and modular skill reuse, Generative Agents simulate memory-driven, socially responsive non-player character (NPC) behaviors, and NVIDIA ACE facilitates emotionally expressive, multimodal dialogue. The analysis identifies key strengths such as improved development efficiency, richer narrative engagement, and real-time interactivity, while also addressing challenges related to computational cost, behavioral coherence, and ethical risks like privacy and bias. This study contributes both theoretically and practically by offering a strategic framework for responsibly integrating AI into game production, enhancing scalability and user immersion while highlighting implementation trade-offs and future research directions.

article-title.#text: Memory as a Stack: On the Reconfiguration of Memory in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
스택으로서의 기억: 인공지능 시대 기억의 재구성에 대하여
Memory as a Stack: On the Reconfiguration of Memory in the Age of Artificial Intelligence

abstract.#text: Human memory is undergoing a significant reconfiguration in the age of artificial intelligence. As Bratton suggests and Kornbluh implies, memory has already been transformed into a stack. Building on these insights, this essay addresses the dangers of turning memory into consumable content and of allowing AI technologies to govern the circulation of digitalized memories. The concern is that memory will soon take the form of memory-capital. This study examines how the link between experience and memory is being effaced, and how AI reshapes the ways in which memory is produced, stored, shared, represented, and ultimately returned to the subject. AI accelerates this process of capitalization and the pursuit of immediacy in memory. The essay reflects on the risk of delinking—the potential dissociation of presence from absence, and experience from memory—resulting from the growing dominance of AI over human remembrance, a condition that further obscures human agency in the production and reproduction of memory.

article-title.#text: Overcoming Integrated Human Cognitive Challenges in Artificial Intelligence Applications
인공지능 활용 과정에서의 인간의 통합 인지능력의 한계와 극복 방안
Overcoming Integrated Human Cognitive Challenges in Artificial Intelligence Applications

abstract.#text:
This study examines the growing reliance on AI(Artificial Intelligence) despite individuals’ inherent capacity to recognize and resolve problems independently. Advances in machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing have accelerated AI diffusion across industries, but this expansion has simultaneously intensified patterns of over-dependence and over-immersion. However, AI fundamentally differs from human intelligence in that it cannot reproduce the integrative cognitive functions unique to humans, including creativity, memory, and critical thinking. Excessive reliance on AI therefore raises concerns about the erosion of essential human capacities.
The purpose of this study is to identify the challenges associated with ensuring AI’s constructive utilization. It reviews the historical evolution and current applications of AI, analyzes emerging issues related to cognitive dependence, and redefines the relationship between AI and human cognition. This study proposes that to overcome AI-induced cognitive challenges, it is essential to implement structured organizational programs, such as creativity bootcamps, that foster independent human insights prior to engaging with algorithmic solutions. Furthermore, it suggests utilizing AI-driven adaptive learning platforms to reinforce memory retention through systematic retrieval practice, while simultaneously establishing robust ethical governance frameworks to ensure accountability and preserve human autonomy in an increasingly automated environment.

article-title.#text: Clinical Application of Artificial Intelligence in Digital Breast Tomosynthesis
디지털 유방 토모신테시스에서 인공지능의 임상 적용
Clinical Application of Artificial Intelligence in Digital Breast Tomosynthesis

author.#text: Jung Min Chang(Department of Radiology, Seoul National University Hospital, Seoul, Korea)
Manisha Bahl(Department of Radiology, Massachusetts General Hospital, Boston, MA, USA)

abstract.#text:
Digital breast tomosynthesis (DBT) provides improved cancer detection and lower recall rates when compared with full-field digital mammography (DM) and has been widely adopted for breast cancer screening. However, adopting DBT presents new challenges such as an increased number of acquired images resulting in longer interpretation times. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers numerous opportunities to enhance the advantages of DBT and mitigate its shortcomings. Research in the DBT AI domain has grown significantly and AI algorithms play a key role in the screening and diagnostic phases of breast cancer detection and characterization.
The application of AI may streamline the workflow and reduce the time required for radiologists to interpret images. In addition, AI can minimize radiation exposure and enhance lesion visibility in synthetic two-dimensional DM images. This review provides an overview of AI technology in DBT, its clinical applications, and future considerations.

article-title.#text: AI-Based Vehicle Damage Repair Price Estimation System
인공지능 기반 차량 파손 수리 가격 산정 시스템
AI-Based Vehicle Damage Repair Price Estimation System

abstract.#text: Artificial intelligence-based estimation of repair costs for damaged vehicles is an emerging field that relies on artificial intelligence and computer vision systems to automatically generate accurate cost estimates. This area of research is becoming increasingly important owing to its potential to streamline the automotive repair industry, enhance overall transparency, improve the accuracy of cost estimation, and expedite insurance claims processing. This paper proposes the identification of the make and model of a vehicle, classification of the damaged vehicle type, and estimation of repair costs based on prices from various vehicle manufacturers. The proposed method for achieving state-of-the-art performance and time-saving in this system is through the use of ResNet50 and transfer learning. We propose a vehicle make and model classification module as well as a damaged vehicle classification module based on ResNet50 and transfer learning to improve the accuracy of the results. The accuracy of vehicle make and model classification module is 88%, which is approximately 11% higher than that of other studies. The accuracy of damaged vehicle classification module in this study is 86%, which is 67% higher than that of other studies.

article-title.#text: Tea Leaf Disease Classification Using Artificial Intelligence (AI) Models
인공지능(AI) 모델을 사용한 차나무 잎의 병해 분류
Tea Leaf Disease Classification Using Artificial Intelligence (AI) Models

author: K.P.S. Kumaratenna(Graduate Student, Department of Horticultural Science, Jeju National University, Jeju 63243, Korea)

abstract.#text: In this study, five artificial intelligence (AI) models: Inception v3, SqueezeNet (local), VGG-16, Painters, and DeepLoc were used to classify tea leaf diseases. Eight image categories were used: healthy, algal leaf spot, anthracnose, bird’s eye spot, brown blight, gray blight, red leaf spot, and white spot. Software used in this study was Orange 3 which functions as a Python library for visual programming, that operates through an interface that generates workflows to visually manipulate and analyze the data. The precision of each AI model was recorded to select the ideal AI model. All models were trained using the Adam solver, rectified linear unit activation function, 100 neurons in the hidden layers, 200 maximum number of iterations in the neural network, and 0.0001 regularizations. To extend the functionality of Orange 3, new add-ons can be installed and, this study image analytics add-on was newly added which is required for image analysis. For the training model, the import image, image embedding, neural network, test and score, and confusion matrix widgets were used, whereas the import images, image embedding, predictions, and image viewer widgets were used for the prediction. Precisions of the neural networks of the five AI models (Inception v3, SqueezeNet (local), VGG-16, Painters, and DeepLoc) were 0.807, 0.901, 0.780, 0.800, and 0.771, respectively. Finally, the SqueezeNet (local) model was selected as the optimal AI model for the detection of tea diseases using tea leaf images owing to its high precision and good performance throughout the confusion matrix.

article-title.#text: From Literacy to Action : Exploring How AI Literacy Shapes Self-Directed Learning Ability
소양에서 행동으로 : 인공지능 소양이 자율 학습 능력에 미치는 영향
From Literacy to Action : Exploring How AI Literacy Shapes Self-Directed Learning Ability

abstract.#text: The development of big data and generative AI is strongly changing how students learn and how universities train talent. This study uses the Technology–Acceptance–Behavior (TAB) view. It studies the relationship between AI literacy and college students’ self-directed learning. It examines the mediating role of technology acceptance. It also examines the moderating role of critical thinking in the link between technology acceptance and learning outcomes. Based on survey data from 407 Chinese university students, the results show the following. AI literacy is positively related to self-directed learning.AI literacy is positively related to students’ technology acceptance. Technology acceptance plays a significant partial mediating role between AI literacy and self-directed learning. Critical thinking significantly moderates the relationship between technology acceptance and self-directed learning. Students with different levels of critical thinking show different patterns. At a high level of critical thinking, self-directed learning depends less on technology acceptance. This shows that AI does not support self-directed learning by itself. Its effect depends on students’ abilities and thinking traits. This study deepens the theory of AI literacy education. It extends the use of the technology acceptance model in AI education. It also provides evidence for universities to develop AI literacy, technology acceptance, and critical thinking together. These findings offer important guidance for higher education reform that focuses on self-directed learning.

article-title.#text: Refonte d’un cursus de traduction professionnelle à l’ère de l’IA générative* : étude de cas en master
인공지능 시대 전문 번역 교과 개편 사례 연구
Refonte d’un cursus de traduction professionnelle à l’ère de l’IA générative* : étude de cas en master

abstract.#text:
Les progrès technologiques transforment le marché de la traduction, marqué par l’essor de la traduction automatique et le développement de la traduction multimodale. En augmentant la vitesse de traitement et le volume des données textuelles, ces technologies réduisent la part de la traduction humaine intégrale pour les contenus à faible valeur ajoutée. Parallèlement, la demande évolue vers des activités de post-édition, de révision et de contrôle de qualité. Dans ce contexte, les profils peu qualifiés tendent à s’effacer au profit des machines, tandis que s’impose le recours à des professionnels dotés d’une solide compétence linguistique et de capacités d’arbitrage et d’adaptation.
Face à ces évolutions, l’École d’Interprétation et de Traduction de l’Université Hankuk des études étrangères a engagé une réforme de son cursus, structurée autour de trois axes : le renforcement des compétences linguistiques avancées, la consolidation des connaissances technologiques et le développement de compétences créatives. Cet article présente cette réforme comme une étude de cas de refonte de la formation en traduction à l’ère de l’intelligence artificielle.

article-title.#text: A Study on the Application of Artificial Intelligence in the Real Estate Sector and Its Future Prospects
부동산 분야에서의 인공지능 활용과 미래전망에 관한 연구
A Study on the Application of Artificial Intelligence in the Real Estate Sector and Its Future Prospects

abstract.#text:
This study aims to comprehensively examine the, impact of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies on the real estate industry and to explore their applications and future, prospects in various fields, including predictive modeling, automated property valuation, urban planning, smart, cities, and asset management.
The real estate market is characterized by significant information asymmetry and regional, disparities, making AI-based decision-making more efficient and accurate than, traditional approaches.
In particular, AI enhances the reliability of predictive models by integratively processing both, structured and unstructured data and identifying underlying market patterns. Automated real estate valuation leverages historical transaction data to learn patterns and thereby reduces, the subjectivity of human appraisers. AI-based risk analysis detects early signs of market anomalies, contributing to, more informed financial and investment decisions. The potential bias embedded in, AI algorithms also poses ethical risks, requiring appropriate institutional responses. AI is a core technology driving, structural transformation in the real estate industry. In conclusion, the establishment, of robust data infrastructure and the advancement of legal and institutional frameworks will, be essential to ensuring sustainable progress.

article-title.#text: A Study on the Artificial Intelligence Curriculum for Non-majors
비전공자를 위한 인공지능 교육과정에 관한 연구
A Study on the Artificial Intelligence Curriculum for Non-majors

abstract.#text: The world is now emphasizing the cultivation of artificial intelligence talents and demanding that not only majors, but also non-majors focus on artificial intelligence education that can actively cope with technological and social changes. However, most of the artificial intelligence curriculum for non-majors is not clear for the objectives of education. Accordingly, both instructors and learners are confused. Therefore, this study analyzes domestic and international artificial intelligence curriculum, presented the objective of education, then presented an educational curriculum based on common elements. As a result, examining the educational effectiveness and self-confidence of non-major learners based on the modified curriculum, significant results were derived. A total of 216 students participated in the experiment during the 2021 to 2022 school year, with 118 learners (control group) received a conceptual and coding-centered curriculum and 98 learners (experimental group) received an improved artificial intelligence curriculum for non-majors, including separation of theory and practice, step-by-step difficulty, and educational materials using everyday life. The learners were divided into a control group and an experimental group, and after learning based on the artificial intelligence curriculum that reflected common elements were reflected, the educational effectiveness and self-confidence were examined and analyzed. In summary of the experiment analysis, the educational effect of the experimental group that learned the Artificial Intelligence curriculum in which common elements were reflected was a coding and program-oriented curriculum, learners without basic coding knowledge, and the absence of reference materials suitable for the learner's level. In addition, in the self-confidence part, it was found that learner motivation to learn, improvement in learning performance, and connection to career influenced improving self-confidence.

article-title.#text: Künstliche Intelligenz und derer rechtsstaatlichen Anforderungen in der koreanischen Verwaltung
한국의 행정에 있어서 인공지능과 그에 대한 법치국가적 요청들
Künstliche Intelligenz und derer rechtsstaatlichen Anforderungen in der koreanischen Verwaltung

abstract.#text:
Künstliche Intelligenz wird schon seit langem erforscht. In den letzten Jahren hat sich jedoch die Rechenleistung von Computern dank der von Nvidia hergestellten Computerchips drastisch erhöht. In Verbindung mit algorithmischen Lernmethoden, dem so genannten Deep Learning, hat dies dazu geführt, dass die Rechenleistung der KI auf praktische Lebensbereiche angewendet werden kann. Der Kern der KI kann als Algorithmus bezeichnet werden, und es stellt sich die Frage, wie Algorithmen rechtlich zu betrachten sind, d. h. ob die Rechtsnatur von Algorithmen als Verwaltungsvorschrift, als Rechtsverordnung, die sich auf das Verwaltungshandeln einer Verwaltungsbehörde auswirkt, oder einfach als ein in einem Computer enthaltenes Element zu betrachten ist. In dieser Hinsicht ist es notwendig, ein praktisches Urteil zu fällen, das auf dem Grad der Beteiligung der künstlichen Intelligenz an den Verwaltungshandlungen beruht, um ihre Rechtsnatur zu bestimmen.
Wenn Algorithmen auch in starke und schwache Algorithmen unterteilt werden, bewegen wir uns in Richtung starke Algorithmen. Starke Algorithmen haben das Problem der Undurchsichtigkeit des algorithmischen Prozesses, weshalb die Diskussion über erklärbare Algorithmen voranschreitet. Es stellt sich die Frage, wie diese erklärbaren Algorithmen mit den Grundrechten der einzelnen Unternehmen, wie der Berufsfreiheit und dem Schutz von Geschäftsgeheimnissen, in Einklang gebracht werden können.
In Korea wird KI auch zunehmend bei Verwaltungsverfügungen und auch anderen Verwaltungsmaßnahmen eingesetzt. Derzeit wird sie eher zur Durchführung von Ermittlungen und zur Sammlung von Informationen zur Vorbereitung von Verwaltungsmaßnahmen als zur Verwaltungsverfügung eingesetzt. Der Einsatz von KI erfordert in erster Linie eine Rechtsgrundlage, und es ist ein Rechtssystem erforderlich, das mit dem Grundsatz der Gewährleistung der Grundrechte gemäß der Verfassung vereinbar ist. Es braucht Regelungen für den Umgang mit Schäden, die durch KI verursacht werden. Die Funktionsweise der künstlichen Intelligenz beruht auf einer großen Menge von Daten, was Fragen nach deren Wahrheitsgehalt, Angemessenheit und Fairness aufwirft. Es gibt auch Forderungen nach Transparenz darüber, wie Algorithmen ausgelöst werden.
Als Rechtsgrundlage für die künstliche Intelligenz sind verschiedene Gesetzesentwürfe in Vorbereitung. Zu den wichtigsten Inhalten gehören die Definition des Begriffs der künstlichen Intelligenz und die Unterscheidung zwischen künstlicher Intelligenz, die besonders in die Grundrechte der Bürger eingreift. Derzeit ist der Einsatz von künstlicher Intelligenz im Zusammenhang mit Verwaltungsakten im Verwaltungsgrundgesetz unter dem Begriff der automatischen Verfügungen geregelt, und die Bestimmungen dieses Artikels sehen vor, dass vollautomatische Verfügungen unter Einsatz künstlicher Intelligenz nur bei gebundenen Verwaltungsakten, nicht aber bei Ermessenshandlungen erlassen werden können. Es ist notwendig, den Erlass von Verwaltungsakten unter Einsatz von KI bei Ermessensentscheidungen zu ermöglichen, und es ist auch notwendig, den Schutz der anderen Partei des Verwaltungsverfahrens nach dem koreanischen Verwaltungsverfahrensgesetz bei Verwaltungsakten unter Einsatz von KI zu harmonisieren.
In Anbetracht der Tatsache, dass das Zeitalter der künstlichen Intelligenz immer näher rückt, müssen systematischere Regeln für den Einsatz von künstlicher Intelligenz im Verwaltungshandeln entwickelt werden.

article-title.#text: The Failure and Paradigm Shift in Academic Plagiarism Governance in the Era of Generative Artificial Intelligence
생성형 인공지능 시대 학술 표절 거버넌스의 실패와 패러다임 전환
The Failure and Paradigm Shift in Academic Plagiarism Governance in the Era of Generative Artificial Intelligence

author: Yan, Yi(西南政法大学 民商法学院)
Zou, Xue Lin(西南政法大学 民商法学院)

abstract.#text: The rise of generative artificial intelligence has not only profoundly transformed the model of human knowledge and production, but also exacerbated the prevalence of academic plagiarism. Generative artificial intelligence can use intelligent writing to make manifestations of originality, such plagiarism-related behaviors still conform to the core features of plagiarism of “concealing the source”. However, the existing governance paradigm centered on “ex-post punishment” has shown a significant “failure” trend. As for international experiences to address this challenge, in terms of normative governance, emphasis is placed on “decentralization” and “institutional adaptability”; in terms of technical governance, “transparency” and “classification detection” are highlighted; and in terms of ethical responsibility, the integration of pre-event education and multiple governance subjects is advocated. Drawing on international experience, the paradigm shift in China’s academic plagiarism governance should employ the technical to trace of originality so as to improve the regulatory mechanism in “all stages”, and with the ethical governance to reconstruct the multi-level responsible mechanism, thus establish a new governance paradigm with the feature of the synergy of technology, law, and ethics.

article-title.#text: 冲击与应对:人工智能时代编辑能力的内涵重构
충격과 대응 : 인공지능 시대 편집 능력의 내실 재구성
Shock and Response: Reorganization of Editorial Ability in the Age of Artificial Intelligence

abstract.#text: 人工智能在选题策划、内容生成、编辑加工、营销推广等出版流程 中有着广泛应用，提升了出版的效率与效益。对于编辑而言，人工智能 也在冲击其在出版活动中的主体地位，异化把关人机制，稀释人类编辑 的情感价值，弱化出版的权威性。编辑能力的内涵需要重构:鉴别力的 核心在于识别与鉴定高质量内容，编辑力强调基于人类主体性的价值引 领与情感输出，传播力注重品牌建设与市场推广，以应对人工智能的冲击。

article-title.#text: A Research to Enhance the Competencies of Instructors and Students in the Field of Healthcare Education Based on the Latest Artificial Intelligence Technology
최신 인공지능 기술을 활용한 최신 최신 인공지능 기술기반 보건의료 교육 분야에서의 교수자 및 학생 직무역량 강화를 위한 연구
A Research to Enhance the Competencies of Instructors and Students in the Field of Healthcare Education Based on the Latest Artificial Intelligence Technology

abstract.#text: This study aims to introduce recently announced major artificial intelligence platforms, their main functions and resources, and technologies that can be utilized in the healthcare academic field, and to suggest essential directions for utilization in healthcare and life care-related education fields using them. To this end, this study first studied the educational goals and characteristics of healthcare and life care-related departments, and clinical job field elements so that they can be understood and approached. As a result, it was confirmed that there are the following characteristics: first, practice-oriented education; second, human-centered education; third, prevention and health promotion-oriented education; fourth, strengthening of technology and data utilization capabilities; fifth, fostering of research and problem-solving capabilities; and sixth, social responsibility and leadership education. For these educational characteristics, the following six application directions were suggested as a plan for organizing and presenting educational content using generative AI engine technology. 1. Provision of customized learning paths and feedback; 2. Simulation and virtual reality (VR)-based practice; 3. Creation of situation-based learning scenarios; 4. Real-time data analysis and utilization education; 5. Cultural sensitivity and ethical judgment education; 6. Continuous learning and leadership development. Based on the above research results, the researcher expects that the composition and application of cutting-edge educational content in the fields of healthcare and life care education using the latest artificial intelligence technology will have a transfer effect to practical and realistic hands-on and practice-centered education for various situations and client cases, and will have a significant effect on improving the educational satisfaction of the department and strengthening student capabilities.

article-title.#text: Artistic Collaboration in the Age of AI: A Perspective from Actor-Network Theory
인공지능 시대의 예술적 협업: 배우-네트워크 이론의 관점
Artistic Collaboration in the Age of AI: A Perspective from Actor-Network Theory

abstract.#text: This paper explores the roles of various actors, including cutting-edge technology and artificial intelligence, in the art creation process from the perspective of Actor-Network Theory (ANT). ANT acts as equal actors in shaping our world for both human and non-human beings, and emphasizes interactions through continuous connection and translation of actions. Through this analysis based on ANT, we examine how these actors contribute to creating new ideas, solving technical challenges, and forming networks within the realm of art through work production. We examine the possibility that collaboration with artificial intelligence can open new avenues for artistic expression.

article-title.#text: Guidelines for big data projects in artificial intelligence mathematics education
인공지능 수학 교육을 위한 빅데이터 프로젝트 과제 가이드라인
Guidelines for big data projects in artificial intelligence mathematics education

abstract.#text: In today’s digital information society, student knowledge and skills to analyze big data and make informed decisions have become an important goal of school mathematics. Integrating big data statistical projects with digital technologies in high school <Artificial Intelligence> mathematics courses has the potential to provide students with a learning experience of high impact that can develop these essential skills. This paper proposes a set of guidelines for designing effective big data statistical project-based tasks and evaluates the tasks in the artificial intelligence mathematics textbook against these criteria. The proposed guidelines recommend that projects should: (1) align knowledge and skills with the national school mathematics curriculum; (2) use preprocessed massive datasets; (3) employ data scientists' problem-solving methods; (4) encourage decision-making; (5) leverage technological tools; and (6) promote collaborative learning. The findings indicate that few textbooks fully align with these guidelines, with most failing to incorporate elements corresponding to Guideline 2 in their project tasks. In addition, most tasks in the textbooks overlook or omit data preprocessing, either by using smaller datasets or by using big data without any form of preprocessing. This can potentially result in misconceptions among students regarding the nature of big data. Furthermore, this paper discusses the relevant mathematical knowledge and skills necessary for artificial intelligence, as well as the potential benefits and pedagogical considerations associated with integrating technology into big data tasks. This research sheds light on teaching mathematical concepts with machine learning algorithms and the effective use of technology tools in big data education.

article-title.#text: Narratives of Artificial Intelligence, the Religions of Modernity, & the Future of Human-computer Interaction
인공지능과 현대종교들, 그리고 미래 인간-컴퓨터 상호작용
Narratives of Artificial Intelligence, the Religions of Modernity, & the Future of Human-computer Interaction

author.#text: Robert, M. Geraci(Manhattan College in New York)

abstract.#text: As the progress and development of hi-tech technologies and sciences such as artificial intelligence, robotics, nanotechnology, neuroscience, cognitive science, and so on, has been so rapid and revolutionary, our civilizational discourse on the future has unfold only on the basis of scientific discourses. Althougdlldlmany are worried about the future of religions in this context, this article argues that the development of artificial intelligence is not purely scientific and materialistic, disconnected from humanistic discourses, but that it rather has been inextricably entangled with humanist ideas. Keeping in mind D. Chakravarty’s idea of privincializing Europe, this article elucidates that the Western discourse of artificial intelligence has been heavily dependent upon that of apocalypse and that the development of the transhumanist discourse especially has been orbited around this Western feature of apocalypse. However, the development of science these days is not confined to the Western world, and thus Indian scientists program the progress of artificial intelligence on the basis of their own Indian culture. For example, Indian scientists can understand Artificial Intelligence as Kalki, the avatar of Vishnu, which will return to the Earth to start the whole process over again. While, Japanese scientist can understand A.I. as part of kami, which is the sacred existing in all forms of beings living and nonliving. In this way, scientist in Asia can more easily understand the symbiosis of human and machine, of human and artificial intelligence, than the Western. Asian cultures have developed deep thoughts on swaraj (self-mastery or self-rule) or compassion based upon their idea of non-self. Thus, if one can refer to diverse cultural ideas and discourses including Asian insights in the development of artificial intelligence, instead of exclusively relying upon the Western confrontational/conflictual model of apocalypse, one can orient the future development of sciences and technologies including artificial intelligence in a better way.

article-title.#text: Analysis of Factors Affecting Teachers' AI and Digital Competencies
교사의 인공지능 및 디지털 역량에 대한 영향 요인 분석
Analysis of Factors Affecting Teachers' AI and Digital Competencies

abstract.#text: This study investigates the factors influencing teachers’ AI and digital competencies amid rapid digital transformation. As part of this study, an online survey, refined through expert review and a pilot study was conducted among teachers in J Province. Hierarchical regression analysis revealed that individual factors—specifically, school level and teaching experience—significantly affect digital competencies, with teachers in lower-level schools and those with less experience demonstrating higher competencies. Adding teacher-specific factors, TPACK, teacher collaboration, and perceptions of usefulness and ease of use emerged as significant predictors. When school-related factors were included, school culture and resources further enhanced competency levels, underscoring the need for a holistic approach to professional development. Discussions on enhancing teachers' AI and digital competencies can be categorized into individual, school, and district levels. At the individual level, teachers need a clear purpose for AI integration and a shared consensus, as those who recognize its benefits tend to have higher competencies.

article-title.#text: A Study on the Applicability of Generative Artificial Intelligence in the Automotive Design Process
자동차 디자인 프로세스에서의 생성형 인공지능의 활용성 고찰
A Study on the Applicability of Generative Artificial Intelligence in the Automotive Design Process

abstract.#text:
Since ChatGPT's introduction in November 2022, generative AI tools such as DALL-E and Midjourney have significantly impacted on automotive design. DALL-E uses Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to align image details with textual prompts, while Midjourney employs Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) to produce realistic images through competing neural networks.
This study explores both tools in automotive design via qualitative and quantitative research methods, using generated images, extracted prompts, and adjective keywords. This study showed DALL-E produced results closer to user intentions compared to Midjourney, supported by user surveys. The study suggests future research should explore language variations, different vehicle types, user expertise, and professional designer insights to expand generative AI's application in design.

인공지능을 활용한 기업 디지털 전환의 핵심 성공요인 분석
An Analysis of the Key Success Factors in Enterprise Digital Transformation through Artificial Intelligence

abstract.#text: 人工智能(Artificial Intelligence, AI)作为企业数字化转型的核心驱动力, 在优化业务流 程、提升决策智能化、升级客户服务以及构建创新生态等方面展现出巨大潜力。聚焦AI在 企业数字化转型中的作用机制与关键成功因素, 构建了 “技术—组织—战略”三维分析框架, 系统剖析AI技术的高效应用、组织内部变革驱动力以及决策流程优化如何共同构成转型成 功的关键支柱。强调开放包容的组织文化和具有战略远见的领导力在推动转型顺利实施中 的不可替代作用。随着AI大模型的快速发展, 企业在拥抱技术红利的同时, 需正视技术伦 理、数据安全等新兴风险的挑战。不仅从理论层面拓展了AI与企业数字化转型的研究框架, 还为企业管理者制定实践策略提供了切实可行的指导。研究可进一步聚焦AI大模型在不同 行业中的应用场景, 并通过实证分析量化各关键因素的权重与优先级, 为设计更精准、高效 的数字化转型路径提供科学依据与支持。

Artificial Intelligence (AI) has emerged as a core driver of enterprise digital transformation, offering significant potential in optimizing business processes, enhancing intelligent decision-making, upgrading customer service, and fostering innovation ecosystems.
This study adopts a “Technology–Organization–Strategy” tri-dimensional analytical framework to systematically examine the mechanisms through which AI enables digital transformation and the critical success factors that underpin it. We analyze how efficient AI adoption, organizational change drivers, and decision-making optimization jointly form the pillars of successful transformation. The research highlights the indispensable roles of an open and inclusive organizational culture and strategically visionary leadership in ensuring smooth implementation. As large-scale AI models advance rapidly, enterprises must not only capture the benefits of these technologies but also address emerging challenges such as ethics and data security risks. This study expands the theoretical framework connecting AI and digital transformation while offering practical guidance for managers. Future research can focus on industry-specific application scenarios of large AI models and conduct empirical analyses to quantify the relative weight and priority of key factors, thereby providing a scientific basis for designing more precise and effective digital transformation pathways.

article-title.#text: 从中国著作权法视角审视人工智能作品
중국 저작권법의 시각에서 인공지능 저작물에 관한 연구
A Study on AI Works from the Perspective of Chinese Copyright Law

author.#text: 王 坤(韩国东亚大学)

abstract.#text:
人工智能系统生成的文章, 音乐, 画作等通常被称为 “人工智能作品”. 在一起 中国最高人民法院认可的案件中, 由软件生成的文章被判定为中国著作权法上 的作品. 本文在该案件的基础上, 对人工智能作品可构成中国著作权法上的作 品, 做了一些分析.
中国著作权法要求, 作品需具有独创性, 并能以一定形式表现. 人工智能作 品通常为文字, 图片, 音乐等, 符合以一定形式表现的要求. 对人工智能作品独 创性的判断, 是其能否为中国著作权法上作品的关键. 首先, 人工智能作品在 内容表达形式上, 可以与已有作品相互区别, 并且不是公有领域的惯常表达, 符 合中国著作权法对作品独创性的要求. 其次, 研发者对人工智能系统的研发行 为, 通常对人工智能作品的内容表达形式具有决定作用, 与人工智能作品的内 容表达形式具有直接关系, 因而, 研发者创作了人工智能作品, 人工智能作品的 独创性源自于自然人. 此时, 我们已经可以认定, 人工智能作品为中国著作权 法上的作品, 研发者为人工智能作品的作者. 再者, 就人工智能系统的使用者 而言, 如果我们通过对人工智能作品的内容表达形式及其生成过程进行分析, 能够确定, 人工智能作品的特定内容表达形式是由使用者行为决定的, 与使用 者行为之间具有直接关系, 则可以认为, 使用者也参与了人工智能作品的创作, 为人工智能作品的作者之一.

Articles, music, paintings, and others generated by AI systems are usually called “AI works”. In a case acknowledged by The Supreme People’s Court of China, an article generated by software was judged to be a work in Chinese Copyright Law. Based on this case, this paper analyzes that AI works can be works in Chinese Copyright Law.
Chinese Copyright Law requires that a work must be original and can be expressed in a certain form. An AI work is usually presented in the form of text, pictures or music, which meets the requirement of being expressed in a certain form. The judgment of the originality of an AI work is the key to whether it is a work in Chinese Copyright Law. First of all, in terms of content expression form, an AI work can be different from existing works, and is not common expressions in the public domain, which meets the requirement for the originality of a work in Chinese Copyright Law. Secondly, the behaviors of researching and developing an AI system by the R & D staff usually play a decisive role in the content expression form of an AI work and have a direct relationship with the content expression form of an AI work. Therefore, the R & D staff has created an AI work, and the originality of an Al work comes from natural persons. At this time, we can recognize that an AI work is a work in Chinese Copyright Law and the R & D staff is the author of an AI work. Moreover, in the user who operates an AI system, by analyzing the content expression form and the generation process of an AI work, if we can be sure that the specific content expression form of an AI work is determined by the behaviors of the user and has a direct relationship with the behaviors of the user, it can be considered that the user has also participated in the creation of an AI work and the user is one of the authors of an AI work.

article-title.#text: AI-Based Modeling for Predicting Open University Student Retention
인공지능을 활용한 개방대학 학생의 학업유지 예측 모델링
AI-Based Modeling for Predicting Open University Student Retention

abstract.#text:
Open university students have more possibility of dropout thanordinary college students. K University has so far conducted ananalysis of who continues or stops studying after the fact. However,artificial intelligence(AI)-based big data analysis has allowed KUniversity to predict students whether to continue or stop studyingduring the semester.
Using the K University data warehouse, this research collectedfour-year data for the entire process from admission to graduation ofabout 100,000 students and made artificial intelligence learn them. TheK University retention model which was developed using multiplealgorithms found more than 220 influencing factors. The K Universityretention prediction system using the ensemble technique wasestablished, and the prediction of students’ retention attending thespring semester of 2023 was realized. The empirical results of the KUniversity retention prediction system were statistically significant. KUniversity began predicting dropout by calculating the possibility ofindividual students’ retention every month during the semester.
According to the results of the dropout prediction, students aredivided into three groups (general, risk, and high risk). The predictionresults of students’ dropouts are provided to faculty members everymonth along with principal learning-related indicators.
Through the artificial intelligence-based retention-dropout predictionmodeling, K University has become possible to provide data-basedstudent support services and institutional administration. There is anactive discussion on what kind of intervention and learning supportwill be possible for students identified as having a high risk or riskof dropout.

article-title.#text: The Convergence of Artificial Intelligence and the Internet of Things (AIoT): Innovations, Challenges, and Future Directions
인공지능과 사물인터넷(AIoT)의 융합: 혁신, 도전 과제, 그리고 미래 방향
The Convergence of Artificial Intelligence and the Internet of Things (AIoT): Innovations, Challenges, and Future Directions

abstract.#text: The convergence of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and the Internet of Things (IoT), known as AIoT, represents a significant technological advancement with profound implications across various industries. AIoT leverages the data generation capabilities of IoT devices and the decision-making power of AI to create intelligent, autonomous systems. This paper explores the key innovations driving AIoT, including smart homes, healthcare, industrial automation, and autonomous vehicles. It also examines the primary challenges, such as security, data management, and ethical concerns, offering solutions and best practices to address these issues. Through a comprehensive review of current literature and analysis of emerging trends, this paper provides insights into the future directions of AIoT, highlighting its potential to revolutionize technology and society.

article-title.#text: Ruling Without Rulers: A Daoist Political Framework for AI Governance
지배 없는 통치: 인공지능 거버넌스를 위한 도가 정치철학 연구
Ruling Without Rulers: A Daoist Political Framework for AI Governance

abstract.#text: As artificial intelligence (AI) systems increasingly mediate decisions across social, political, and economic spheres, prevailing governance models-rooted in liberal legalism, technocratic control, and risk-management frameworks-struggle to adapt to the complexities of distributed, opaque, and evolving machine systems. This paper proposes a Daoist political framework for AI governance, drawing upon foundational concepts from classical Daoism such as wuwei (non-coercive action), ziran (emergent natural order), and de (ethical potency). These principles offer a philosophical and practical alternative to dominant paradigms of control, emphasizing contextual responsiveness, moral resonance, and the strategic value of restraint. The paper critically reviews existing Western approaches to AI governance, including liberal rights-based regulation, technocratic optimization, and critical theory’s focus on platform power. While each contributes valuable insights, they often lack the ontological flexibility and ethical adaptability required for governing intelligent systems. In contrast, Daoist political thought reframes governance as resonance rather than rule, highlighting the importance of self-organization, ambiguity tolerance, and ethical alignment over enforcement. Addressing common critiques-such as the cultural specificity of Daoism or its supposed institutional vagueness-the study argues for the utility of Daoist concepts in designing hybrid, post-Western governance architectures. These models would not reject regulation but reinterpret it as a participatory and evolving process, aligned with the rhythms of dynamic systems rather than imposed upon them. Ultimately, the Daoist approach calls for a shift from commanding systems to cultivating conditions for co-evolution between humans and machines. In an era of entangled agency and algorithmic opacity, Daoist political theory offers a timely, pluralistic, and morally grounded path forward-one that seeks not to dominate complexity, but to dwell within it wisely.

article-title.#text: A Study on Artificial Intelligent-based Trajectory Pattern Mining for Smart Vehicular Traffic
스마트 차량 트래픽을 위한 인공지능 기반 경로패턴 마이닝에 관한 연구
A Study on Artificial Intelligent-based Trajectory Pattern Mining for Smart Vehicular Traffic

abstract.#text: Recently, with the rapid growth and widespread use of GPS devices, RFID sensors using Internet of Things, wireless communication, and artificial intelligent, it has become possible to track various moving objects in real-world. In addition, an increasing number of trajectories are being collected and stored in databases, often containing valuable knowledge that requires urgent analysis. As the adoption of location acquisition technologies increases, here is a growing opportunity to collect large-scale spatio-temporal datasets and discover actionable knowledge about moving behaviors, fostering the development of new applications and services. The main functionalities and modules of activity pattern discovery system include trajectory preprocessing, trajectory clustering, periodic pattern discovery, and an extensible visualization module for parameter interaction and result presentation. In the experimental part, we validate the accuracy and efficiency of activity pattern discovery system using taxi trajectory data from Korea. In this paper, we develop an extension of the sequential pattern mining paradigm to analyze trajectories of moving objects in this direction. In addition, we introduce trajectory patterns as concise descriptions of frequent behaviors in terms of space and time. In this setting, we propose a general formalization for the novel mining problem and then study several different instances of varying complexities. Fianlly, we empirically evaluate different approaches on real-world data and synthetic benchmarks to compare their strengths and weaknesses.

article-title.#text: Implikationen auf Korea von der KI-Regulierung in der Europäischen Union und USA
유럽연합과 미국의 인공지능(AI) 규율과 우리나라에의 시사점
Implikationen auf Korea von der KI-Regulierung in der Europäischen Union und USA

abstract.#text:
In der modernen Gesellschaft wird künstliche Intelligenz in verschiedenen Formen in allen Lebensbereichen eingesetzt, von einfachen Haushaltsgegenständen bis hin zu verschiedenen Produktionsmaschinen, Transport und Kommunikation, und ist für die Entwicklung und das Überleben der Menschheit unerlässlich geworden.
In letzter Zeit werden immer mehr Roboter in der Industrie eingesetzt, und Drohnen erleichtern das Leben der Menschen durch das Sprühen von Pestiziden und die Rettung von Menschen in bergigem Gelände. Andererseits gibt es Bedenken, dass KI für die Entwicklung von Waffen missbraucht werden und der Menschheit schweren Schaden zufügen könnte, und außerdem könnte die Entwicklung hochentwickelter KI-Technologie eines Tages die menschliche Intelligenz durch Selbstlernen übertreffen.
Dies wirft die Frage auf, wie künstliche Intelligenz reguliert und verwaltet werden kann, damit sie gut entwickelt und aktiv im menschlichen Leben eingesetzt werden kann, aber auch, damit sie der Menschheit keinen ernsthaften Schaden zufügt.
In den Vereinigten Staaten wurde das Thema schon früh in Form von Einzelgesetzen diskutiert und aufgegriffen, und 2023 wurde die Durchführungsverordnung der Regierung Biden zur KI erlassen. In der Europäischen Union wurde der EU-AI Act im Juni 2024 nach mehr als drei Jahren Diskussion verabschiedet.
Dementsprechend begannen die Diskussionen über die Verabschiedung von KI-Gesetzen in Korea schon früh, und in der Sitzungsperiode 2020-2023 wurden der Nationalversammlung 13 Gesetzesentwürfe vorgelegt, und 2024 wurden der Nationalversammlung bereits 16 KI-bezogene Gesetzesentwürfe vorgelegt.
Betrachtet man die KI-Gesetze in den USA und in der EU, so wird allgemein davon ausgegangen, dass sich das US-KI-Gesetz eher auf die Unterstützung der Entwicklung und Nutzung von KI als auf deren Regulierung konzentriert, während das EU-KI-Gesetz eher auf Regulierung ausgerichtet ist.
Hier ist es notwendig, die KI-Gesetzgebung der Vereinigten Staaten und der Europäischen Union zu studieren und sich aktiv auf sie zu beziehen, um eine KI-bezogene Gesetzgebung vorzubereiten und umzusetzen, die der tatsächlichen Situation in Korea entspricht.
So legt das europäische KI-Gesetz Grundprinzipien (wie z. B. Menschlichkeit) und klare Ziele für die Nutzung von KI-Entwicklungen sowie Maßnahmen zur Gewährleistung der Sicherheit für die Vermeidung von Risiken und die reibungslose Nutzung von KI (wie z. B. Risikoeinstufung und entsprechende Disziplin, Meldepflichten und Transparenz) fest, Die Sicherstellung der Verantwortlichkeit für Verstöße (Bußgelder für Verstöße, Schadensersatz usw.) und die Sicherstellung verfahrensrechtlicher Rechtsmittel (Recht auf Einlegung von Beschwerden, Recht auf Erläuterung von Entscheidungen, Schutz von Personen, die Verstöße melden, usw.) können wichtige Auswirkungen auf die künftige Verabschiedung und Anwendung von KI-Gesetzen in Korea haben. Darüber hinaus können die verschiedenen AI-bezogenen Unterstützungssysteme und das organische Kooperationssystem der entsprechenden Verwaltungsbehörden, die im U.S. AI Act festgelegt sind, als gute Referenz für die Unterstützung der AI-bezogenen Entwicklung und Nutzung in Korea und die organische Arbeitsweise der entsprechenden Behörden dienen. Insbesondere sind wir der Meinung, dass Korea den ausgereiften Weg der Einführung und Durchsetzung von KI-bezogenen Politiken und Gesetzen aktiver einschlagen muss, was eine langfristige Planung und eine ausreichend lange Zeit der Beratung aus verschiedenen Blickwinkeln erfordert, um einen reibungslosen gesellschaftlichen Konsens zu erreichen.

article-title.#text: Predicting Earnings Management in Korean Firms Using Explainable AI
설명가능한 인공지능을 활용한 한국 기업의 이익조정 예측
Predicting Earnings Management in Korean Firms Using Explainable AI

abstract.#text: This research explores how machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), and explainable AI (XAI) can be applied to identify earnings management (EM) among Korean listed companies over the 2015–2024 period. We demonstrate model-task specialization: Ensemble SoftVoting best predicts AEM, while Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) excel in REM detection, reflecting distinct underlying logics. Our XAI analysis introduces a dual-logic framework explaining distinct theoretical mechanisms behind AEM and REM. We find models independently learn two distinct theoretical logics: (1) AEM is identified as an Opportunistic response to Financial Distress and Liquidity Constraints (driven by Interest Coverage and Net Income, validating the Financial Distress Hypothesis); and (2) REM is identified as a Strategic response to Political Costs and Market Visibility (driven primarily by Firm Size and Profitability, validating the Political Cost Hypothesis). This framework bridges the long-standing accuracy- interpretability gap by uncovering distinct theoretical logics underlying AEM and REM. The findings provide actionable insights for auditors and regulators to design theory-grounded oversight mechanisms in high-stakes financial contexts. Specifically, this study answers two research questions concerning model performance and explainable-theory alignment.

article-title.#text: Establishing a Conceptual Framework for Offender Profiling in the Age of AI
인공지능(AI) 시대의 범죄자 프로파일링을 위한 개념적 프레임워크 정립
Establishing a Conceptual Framework for Offender Profiling in the Age of AI

abstract.#text:
This article argues that the central challenge posed by artificial intelligence (AI) in contemporary criminal investigations is institutional rather than technical: it concerns how investigative judgment should be structured and constrained in data-driven environments. Against this background, the study examines the evolving role of offender profiling and seeks to reconceptualize it not as a predictive or decision- substituting tool, but as an interpretive framework designed to preserve investigative accountability.
Methodologically, the study adopts a conceptual and theoretical approach, drawing upon criminological theory, digital forensic analysis, and emerging scholarship on AI governance. By analyzing digitally mediated criminal environments, fragmented behavioral traces, adaptive offender behavior, and the limits of automation, the article develops a structured conceptual framework that positions offender profiling as a mediating layer between AI-generated analytical outputs and human investigative decision-making. The findings suggest that profiling functions as an interpretive and structuring mechanism within the architecture of suspicion formation, linking data generation, algorithmic ordering, and investigative judgment.
The study further demonstrates that AI not only enhances analytical capacity but also reconfigures the informational and institutional conditions under which suspicion is produced and evaluated.
Accordingly, the article proposes a governance-oriented framework emphasizing contestability, traceability, and distributed responsibility.
Within this framework, profiling supports hypothesis formation and clarifies decision-relevant issues, while final investigative decisions and responsibility attribution remain exclusively with human investigators.
The model also introduces a stage-sensitive structure governing the use of profiling across the investigative process: although profiling may contribute during early-stage analysis and direction-setting, it is excluded from coercive decision-making stages. This design prevents probabilistic or algorithmic outputs from serving as direct grounds for coercive state action.
Rather than offering a technical solution, the proposed framework advances an institutional and conceptual design for preserving accountability and constraining investigative discretion in AI-assisted policing. By clarifying the role and limits of offender profiling, this study contributes to scholarship on the governance of emerging technologies and the preservation of human judgment in contemporary criminal investigations.

article-title.#text: An Exploratory Research on the Perceptions and Attitudes of Chinese University Students Towards Artificial Intelligence (AI) Education as Liberal Arts Courses
중국 대학생의 교양과목으로서의 인공지능 (AI) 교육에 대한 인식과 태도 연구
An Exploratory Research on the Perceptions and Attitudes of Chinese University Students Towards Artificial Intelligence (AI) Education as Liberal Arts Courses

abstract.#text: In the Fourth Industrial Revolution era, awareness of artificial intelligence and the ability to apply it within one's field are essential skills for university students majoring in computer-related fields and non-majors. The Chinese Ministry of Education has emphasized the "Artificial Intelligence + N" education model, initiating AI education as a liberal arts subject for non-majors in Chinese universities. Consequently, when designing AI courses for non-majors, it is crucial to thoroughly understand the AI learning experiences, perceptions, and attitudes of a diverse student population. This study aims to investigate the perceptions of AI learning experiences and attitudes towards AI education among non-majors at a Chinese university to inform the future direction of AI education as a liberal arts subject. To achieve this, a survey was conducted in the first semester of 2023, targeting 607 non-major students at S University in China. The study yielded the following results: First, most Chinese university students hold very positive perceptions of AI education and strongly believe in the necessity of AI education for non-majors. Second, statistically significant differences in perceptions and attitudes towards AI were observed based on whether students had prior AI learning experiences. Students with AI learning experiences before entering university had more positive perceptions of AI than those without such experiences. These findings suggest potential directions for AI education as a liberal arts subject in Chinese universities and provide valuable insights for designing AI courses tailored to non-majors.
