article-title.#text: 中国人工智能生成物的著作权归属研究
중국의 인공지능 생성물에 대한 저작권 귀속에 관한 연구
Research on Copyright Ownership for AI Generated Contents in China

author.#text: 왕하이옌(四川轻化工大学法学院讲师)
오가리(四川轻化工大学法学院)

abstract.#text: 在知识产权领域，人工智能作为人类的新型创作工具，因其“创作”生成物的著作权权利归属不明确引发了众多问题。随着生成式人工智能技术的快速发展，如ChatGPT、DeepSeek等工具的广泛应用，使其生成物在质量与效率上的优势对传统创作行为形成冲击，模糊了人类创作主体的核心地位，同时因数据来源与算法黑箱的复杂性，导致生成物存在侵权责任认定困难的情况，严重影响了著作权法的激励功能实现，加剧社会不平等现象。解决著作权权利归属问题，不仅是应对当前法律困境的基础，更是推动人工智能创作健康发展、完善著作权法理论体系与制度建设的关键。当前人工智能生成物著作权权利归属模式主要有人工智能主体说、使用者说、设计者说、投资者说等四种学说，对四种模式进行法理逻辑与实践检验分析，提出确认著作权权利归属应遵循人本主义、成本与收益对等及公众利益优先等三大原则，强调人工智能生成物之权利归属须服务于人类社会，保障技术红利公平分配等基本理念。在具体制度设计上，一是主张以尊重当事人意思自治为前提，允许开发者、使用者与投资者通过合同约定权属分配；二是构建以使用者为核心的权利归属制度，明确使用者在生成过程中的主导地位；三是采用梯度权属分配模式，根据人类参与创作贡献度大小确定权属；四是建立人工智能生成物的自愿登记制度，明确生成物来源与责任主体；五是完善标识义务，为侵权救济与市场管理提供依据。厘清人工智能生成物的权利归属，可以为人工智能生成物的法律保护提供新思路，促进人工智能技术与著作权法的协同发展：一方面引导技术向善，避免人类主体性被技术消解；另一方面推动著作权法适应数字化时代需求，完善理论框架与制度设计，最终实现技术创新、创作者权利保护与公共利益维护的多元平衡。

In the field of intellectual property, as a new creative tool for humans, AI has triggered numerous issues due to the unclear copyright ownership of the works generated by its “creations”. With the rapid development of generative AI technologies, such as the widespread application of tools like ChatGPT and DeepSeek, the advantages of AI Generated Contents in terms of quality and efficiency have impacted traditional creative behaviors, obscuring the core position of human creators. Meanwhile, due to the complexity of data sources and algorithmic black boxes, it has become difficult to determine the liability for infringement in AI Generated Contents, seriously affecting the realization of the incentive function of copyright law and exacerbating social inequality. Solving the problem of copyright ownership is not only the foundation for addressing current legal challenges but also the key to promoting the healthy development of AI-generated creations and improving the theoretical system and institutional construction of copyright law. Currently, there are four main theories regarding the copyright ownership model for AI Generated Contents: the AI subject theory, the user theory, the designer theory, and the investor theory. Through a jurisprudential logic and practical inspection analysis of these four models, this paper proposes that confirming copyright ownership should follow three principles: humanism, the equivalence of costs and benefits, and the priority of public interests, emphasizing that the ownership of rights in AI Generated Contents must serve human society and ensure the fair distribution of technological dividends. In terms of specific system design. Firstly, it is advocated that, on the premise of respecting the autonomy of the parties' will, developers, users and investors should be allowed to stipulate the ownership allocation through contracts. Secondly, constructing a right ownership system with users at its core to clarify the dominant position of users in the generation process. Thirdly, adopting a gradient ownership allocation model to determine ownership based on the size of human contribution to creation. Fourthly, establishing a resource registration system for AI-generated works to clarify the source of generated works and the responsible subjects. Fifthly, improving the labeling obligations to provide a basis for infringement relief and market management. Clarifying the ownership of rights in AI Generated Contents can provide new ideas for the legal protection of such works and promote the collaborative development of AI technology and copyright law. On the one hand, it guides technology toward goodness and prevents the erosion of human subjectivity by technology; on the other hand, it promotes the adaptation of copyright law to the needs of the digital age, improves the theoretical framework and institutional design, and ultimately achieves a multiple balance among technological innovation, the protection of creators' rights, and the maintenance of public interests.

article-title.#text: Exploring Narrative Intelligence in AI : Implications for the Evolution of Homo narrans
인공지능의 서사 지능 탐구 : 새로운 서사 생태계와 호모 나랜스의 진화
Exploring Narrative Intelligence in AI : Implications for the Evolution of Homo narrans

author.#text: 권호창(Cinema Studies, Korea National University of Arts)

abstract.#text: Narratives are fundamental to human cognition and social culture, serving as the primary means by which individuals and societies construct meaning, share experiences, and convey cultural and moral values. The field of artificial intelligence, which seeks to mimic human thought and behavior, has long studied story generation and story understanding, and today's Large Language Models are demonstrating remarkable narrative capabilities based on advances in natural language processing. This situation raises a variety of changes and new issues, but a comprehensive discussion of them is hard to find. This paper aims to provide a holistic view of the current state and future changes by exploring the intersections and interactions of human and AI narrative intelligence. This paper begins with a review of multidisciplinary research on the intrinsic relationship between humans and narrative, represented by the term Homo narrans, and then provide a historical overview of how narrative has been studied in the field of AI. This paper then explore the possibilities and limitations of narrative intelligence as revealed by today's Large Language Models, and present three philosophical challenges for understanding the implications of AI with narrative intelligence.

article-title.#text: Informativität und Kohäsion von KI-Übersetzungen − Mit Fokus auf Textualität und Surprisal
인공지능 번역의 정보성과 결속구조 - 텍스트성과 Surprisal을 중심으로
Informativität und Kohäsion von KI-Übersetzungen − Mit Fokus auf Textualität und Surprisal

abstract.#text:
Diese Studie analysiert Kohäsion und Informativität in Human- und KI-Übersetzungen nicht-literarischer Texte aus textlinguistischer Perspektive.
Verglichen wurden Übersetzungen eines koreanischen Nachrichtentextes durch eine menschliche Übersetzerin bzw. einen Übersetzer sowie durch GPT-4o. Im Mittelpunkt der qualitativen Analyse standen die Kohäsionselemente Rekurrenz, Proformen und Ellipsen sowie Informativität. Ergänzend wurde der Surprisal-Wert als quantitativer Indikator herangezogen.
Die Ergebnisse zeigen signifikante Unterschiede in der Übersetzungsstrategie: Menschliche Übersetzung setzte stärker auf ökonomische Informationsverarbeitung durch Ellipsen und Pronominalisierung, während die KI eine konsistentere und explizitere Struktur durch Rekurrenz und nominale Ergänzungen verfolgte.
Diese Strategien spiegeln unterschiedliche Gewichtungen zwischen Kohäsion und Informationsstrukturierung wider. Während menschliche Übersetzungen Lesermotivation und Textfluss betonen, priorisiert die KI Klarheit und Stabilität.
Die Erkenntnisse liefern praxisrelevante Implikationen für die Nutzung maschineller Übersetzungen sowie für den Bereich des Post-Editings.

article-title.#text: Offender Profiling as the Structural Logic of Suspicion in AI-Mediated Investigations
인공지능 수사 환경에서의 범죄자 프로파일링: 의심 형성의 구조적 논리 모델
Offender Profiling as the Structural Logic of Suspicion in AI-Mediated Investigations

abstract.#text: The expansion of digital infrastructures and the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into criminal investigations have fundamentally transformed the epistemic conditions under which suspicion is formed. Whereas traditional investigations operated under conditions of informational scarcity, contemporary investigative environments are characterized by data saturation and algorithmic mediation. Suspicion increasingly emerges not from isolated observations but from layered processes in which data are aggregated, ordered, interpreted, and operationalized. Despite this transformation, offender profiling continues to be debated primarily in terms of predictive accuracy and methodological validity, leaving its structural role within investigative reasoning insufficiently examined. This article reconceptualizes offender profiling not as a predictive technique but as the structural logic through which suspicion is organized in AI-mediated investigations. It develops a layered model of suspicion formation consisting of data expansion, algorithmic ordering, profiling interpretation, investigative judgment, and legal evaluation, and situates profiling at the interpretive core of this architecture. The analysis further demonstrates that profiling performs temporally distinct functions across investigative stages—generative, stabilizing, and justificatory—thereby revealing its dynamic role in structuring the movement of suspicion over time. By shifting attention from predictive performance to structural and temporal dynamics, the article argues that the legitimacy of profiling depends not solely on its empirical reliability but on the procedural conditions under which suspicion is formed and governed. In doing so, the study contributes to a broader understanding of investigative epistemology in technologically mediated environments and repositions profiling as a foundational mechanism in the architecture of contemporary criminal investigation.

article-title.#text: Automation & the Future of Work: When Artificial Intelligence Meets Schumpeterian Innovators
생산자동화와 직업의 미래: 인공지능이 슘페터식 혁신가를 만날 때
Automation & the Future of Work: When Artificial Intelligence Meets Schumpeterian Innovators

abstract.#text:
Building on the task-based production models augmented with Schumpeterian innovation, we develop a theoretical framework to analyze the labor market impacts of the introduction of artificial intelligence (AI) to the R&D sector. Innovators allocate scientists’ time between automation of existing tasks and creation of new varieties of tasks to maximize their profits. The introduction of AI or general-purpose R&D technologies expands the frontier of the automation possibility set to encompass all existing tasks. In this milieu, task innovators prioritize the automation of the most profitable tasks – which depends on task specific wage, market size, capital productivity, and the innovator’s bargaining power.
Therefore, unlike the previous waves of automation, new “AI” based automation technologies can pose a significant threat to high-skilled workers. Moreover, the advent of new R&D technologies raises the cost of creating new tasks and slows down the obsolescence of existing ones. Combined with faster task automation, ironically, the dynamics of the R&D sector may eventually decelerate widening income inequality among workers.

article-title.#text: From Artificial Intelligence to Quantum Logic: A Philosophical Response to the Crisis of Anti-mechanism
인공지능에서 양자논리학으로: 반기계론의 위기에 대한 철학적 대응
From Artificial Intelligence to Quantum Logic: A Philosophical Response to the Crisis of Anti-mechanism

abstract.#text:
In this article, quantum logic is suggested as a solution to the crisis of antimechanism, which insists that mind can never be emerged in AI. As it is known, although Gödel sentence is the king pin to collapse the argument of mechanism, which asserts mind can surely be emerged in AI, revenge problem occurred due to self-referentiality becomes the double edged sword for and against anti-mechanists. In other words, Gödel sentence, which says, “this sentence can not be proved.” is not just the final blow from anti-mechanists to mechanists but it is also the finishing blow the other way around.


To clarify the idea above, Lucas and Penrose are first called upon to briefly summarize the debate centered on Gödel sentence between mechanists and antimechanists. Secondly, Tarskian hierarchy of languages, Kripke’s completeness theorem, and Priest’s dialetheism are examined if any of those can solve the self-referential problem. Lastly, quantum logic is suggested as a solution to the crisis of anti-mechanists that are being attacked by their own weapon of Gödelian style sentence.

First-order predicate calculus (FOPC) have the basic syntax and semantics of FOPC. We discuss the properties of validity and feasibility, and the problem of deciding whether a formula is valid. article-title.#text: Impact of generative artificial intelligence (AI) on the English writing of Korean university students: based on Activity Theory
생성형 인공지능(AI)이 한국 대학생의 영어 작문에 미치는 영향: 활동 이론을 바탕으로
Impact of generative artificial intelligence (AI) on the English writing of Korean university students: based on Activity Theory

abstract.#text: This study examines the impact of generative artificial intelligence (AI) on the English writing of Korean university students. Using activity theory as a framework, the researcher examined the writing strategies and outcomes of two groups of students: those with high English proficiency and those with average English proficiency. Adopting a qualitative case study design, the study engaged ten undergraduates from two leading Korean universities. Data were collected through interviews and essay-writing tasks, and the essays were evaluated for originality, coherence, and critical ability. The results reveal that AI tools boosted students’ confidence and efficiency in writing. However, proficiency differences shaped outcomes: high-proficiency students tended to critically evaluate AI’s suggestions, while average-proficiency students often relied on AI uncritically. Across both groups, AI enhanced fluency and grammatical accuracy but showed limitations in fostering originality. Pedagogically, the findings suggest that AI should be incorporated into English writing instruction in ways that promote critical AI literacy and emphasize human agency in writing. The study is limited by its small sample size, which restricts generalizability. Future research should expand to include larger and more diverse student populations, and compare the impact of different AI platforms (e.g., Grammarly, Gemini, and ChatGPT).

본 연구는 생성형 인공지능(AI)이 한국 대학생의 영어 작문에 미치는 영향을 고찰한다. 활동 이론을 틀로 삼아 연구자는 영어 능력이 높은 학생 그룹과 평균적인 학생 그룹, 두 그룹의 작문 전략과 결과를 분석하였다. 질적 사례연구 설계를 채택하여 국내 주요 대학 두 곳의 학부생 10명을 대상으로 연구를 진행하였다. 인터뷰와 에세이 작성 과제를 통해 데이터를 수집했으며, 에세이는 독창성, 논리성, 비판적 사고 능력을 기준으로 평가되었다. 결과에 따르면 AI 도구는 학생들의 글쓰기 자신감과 효율성을 향상시켰다. 그러나 능력 차이에 따라 결과가 달라졌다. 고 능력 학생들은 AI의 제안을 비판적으로 평가하는 경향이 있었던 반면, 평균 능력 학생들은 종종 비판적 사고 없이 AI에 의존했다. 두 집단 모두에서 AI는 유창성과 문법 정확성을 향상시켰으나 독창성 함양에는 한계가 있었다. 교육학적 관점에서 본 연구 결과는 비판적 AI 활용 능력 함양과 글쓰기에서의 인간 주체성 강조를 통해 AI를 영어 작문 교육에 통합해야 함을 시사한다. 본 연구는 표본 규모가 작아 일반화 가능성에 한계가 있다. 향후 연구는 더 크고 다양한 학생 집단으로 확대하고, 서로 다른 AI 플랫폼의 영향을 비교해야 한다 (예: Grammarly, Gemini, and ChatGPT).

article-title.#text: A Case Analysis of Artificial Intelligence-Based Financial Systems Aimed at Mitigating Investor Behavioral Biases
투자자의 행동편향 완화를 위한 인공지능 기반 금융 시스템 사례 분석
A Case Analysis of Artificial Intelligence-Based Financial Systems Aimed at Mitigating Investor Behavioral Biases

abstract.#text: The field of behavioral finance has extensively explored the ways in which cognitive biases and irrational decision-making patterns adversely affect the investment performance of individuals. This research investigates how investor biases can be addressed within digital platforms by combining insights from behavioral finance with the capabilities of artificial intelligence (AI). Through an analysis of roboadvisory services such as Betterment and Wealthfront, as well as Korean fintech platforms including Kakao Pay Securities and Toss, this study explores how behavioral finance principles are practically implemented in digital investment environments. The findings indicate that tailored, AI-powered investment guidance, along with automated portfolio strategies and digital nudging methods, can play a significant role in reducing cognitive biases such as overconfidence and loss aversion. This combined strategy demonstrates considerable promise in fostering more stable and rational investor behavior, ultimately contributing to improved long-term financial performance. Also the study discusses the practical implications and limitations of AI-based digital behavioral finance strategies and proposes future research directions.

article-title.#text: Comparative Effects of AI and Peer Collaboration on L2 Writing Proficiency: An Empirical Study
인공지능과 학습자 상호작용이 영어 작문 능력에 미치는 효과 분석
Comparative Effects of AI and Peer Collaboration on L2 Writing Proficiency: An Empirical Study

abstract.#text: This study examines the effectiveness of ChatGPT as a pedagogical tool in L2-English writing instruction over a semester. With L1-Korean college students as participants, the study compares the outcomes of a peer-interacted group (n = 34) with those of an AI-interacted group (n = 42). Both groups wrote argumentative essays responding to the same prompts and completed identical pre- and post-writing activities, including brainstorming and debating given essay topics. The only difference lay in the learners’ interaction partners during the activities: peers or ChatGPT. The results of a pretest and four posttests (three immediate and one delayed), scored on content, language use, and organization, show that the AI-interaction group consistently outperformed the peer-interaction group, specifically in content on the first posttest and language use on subsequent posttests. Furthermore, the peer-interaction group’s scores sharply declined on the delayed posttest, while the AI-interaction group maintained consistent performance, suggesting lasting benefits of interacting with ChatGPT. Follow-up interviews, however, revealed the learners’ ambivalence toward using ChatGPT in their writing process. The students appreciated the AI’s prompt and effective editing; however, they raised concerns about its lack of creativity and originality as well as the ethics of incorporating its content suggestions into their essays. Pedagogical implications and potential avenues for future research are discussed.

article-title.#text: Advancing AI Governance and Lawmaking in China -Insights and Strategies-
중국의 인공지능 거버넌스 및 법률 제정에 관한 고찰 -통찰력과 전략-
Advancing AI Governance and Lawmaking in China -Insights and Strategies-

author.#text: 구오단양(School of Law, Tsinghua University;Institute for AI&LAW, Tsinghua University)

abstract.#text: In today’s rapidly evolving technological landscape, Artificial Intelligence (AI) stands out as a pivotal force propelling economic and societal advancements. The rapid evolution of AI technology is revolutionizing operational modalities across various sectors, altering employment patterns, and reshaping everyday life experiences. However, this accelerated development also introduces numerous challenges, including ethical concerns, data security, and privacy protection. Against this backdrop, this paper delves into the dynamics of AI governance and legislation in China, within the context of global trends, with a specific emphasis on those from Western nations. It examines the unique methods and challenges of current AI governance in China. The paper advocates for a unified legislative approach that integrates specific AI solutions with overarching ethical principles. It highlights the essential nature of ethical governance and emphasizes the critical importance of transparency and accountability in the development of AI. Concluding with a call for agile and forward-looking legislation, the paper underscores the necessity for a balanced framework in China that intertwines technological advancements in AI with societal and individual interests.

article-title.#text: A Case Study on the Creative Works of Media Art Using Generative Artificial Intelligence Images
생성형 인공지능 이미지를 활용한 미디어아트 창작 작품 사례 연구 -
A Case Study on the Creative Works of Media Art Using Generative Artificial Intelligence Images

abstract.#text: With the recent development of various generative artificial intelligence program technologies and popular commercialization, media art creative cases using generative artificial intelligence are increasing. Just as the appearance of photographs does not replace existing painting works and exists in new art forms, media art expressions using generative artificial intelligence technology can also exist in new ways and forms. As in the cases created using the generative artificial intelligence programs listed in the paper, it is proved as a single work. Therefore, this paper aims to examine the meaning of artificial intelligence and examples of works using generative artificial intelligence that have been formed historically, and to analyze media art works formed based on generative artificial intelligence programs that exist in various forms. Through this, the creator freely uses the generative artificial intelligence technology that exists based on vast amounts of big data as a work of art, and it is intended to contribute to the production and methodology of media art displayed in various forms.

article-title.#text: Künstliche Intelligenz im DaF-Unterricht - Ein didaktischer Ansatz zur Förderung interkultureller Kompetenz
외국어로서의 독일어수업에서 인공지능의 활용 - 상호문화 능력 향상을 위한 교육적 접근
Künstliche Intelligenz im DaF-Unterricht - Ein didaktischer Ansatz zur Förderung interkultureller Kompetenz

abstract.#text:
In jüngerer Zeit wächst das wissenschaftliche Interesse an der Integration generativer KI-Anwendungen in den Fremdsprachenunterricht. Während erste Studien im Bereich DaF überwiegend auf die Anwendung von KI in der Grammatikund Schreibdidaktik fokussieren, fehlt bislang eine systematische Auseinandersetzung mit ihrem Potenzial zur Förderung interkultureller Kompetenz. Diese Forschungslücke greift der vorliegende Beitrag auf.
Ziel der Untersuchung war es, didaktische Möglichkeiten aufzuzeigen, wie generative KI – insbesondere durch gezielte Promptgestaltung und pädagogische Begleitung – die Entwicklung interkultureller Handlungsfähigkeit im DaF-Unterricht unterstützen kann. Im theoretischen Teil wurden zentrale Begriffe wie „generative KI im DaF-Kontext“ und „interkulturelle Kompetenz als Bildungsziel“ definiert und in den aktuellen Forschungsstand eingebettet.
Das dritte Kapitel beleuchtet die Rolle der Lehrenden als interkulturelle Vermittler: innen sowie die Bedeutung einer reflektierten Promptgestaltung. Es wird betont, dass Lehrende nicht nur als Technikanwender agieren, sondern KI bewusst, kritisch und lernzielorientiert einsetzen müssen. Ethische Herausforderungen wie algorithmische Verzerrung, mangelnde Transparenz und Datenverantwortung wurden ebenfalls thematisiert.
Im vierten Kapitel werden praxisnahe Unterrichtsmodelle vorgestellt, in denen KI als unterstützendes Medium für Perspektivwechsel, Reflexion und interkulturelle Mediation fungiert. Dabei kommen sowohl kontrastive Landeskunde-Aufgaben als auch KI-gestützte Rollenspiele zum Einsatz, die eine vertiefte Auseinandersetzung mit kultureller Differenz ermöglichen.
Insgesamt zeigt die Untersuchung, dass generative KI kein Ersatz, sondern ein begleitendes didaktisches Mittel zur Erweiterung interkultureller Bildungsprozesse sein kann – vorausgesetzt, sie wird im Zusammenspiel mit technischer, didaktischer und ethischer Kompetenz verantwortungsvoll in den Unterricht eingebunden.

article-title.#text: Research Trends in Artificial Intelligence in Education: A Focus on Articles Published in International Journal of Artificial Intelligence in Education
인공지능 교육의 연구 동향: International Journal of Artificial Intelligence in Education 게재 논문들을 중심으로
Research Trends in Artificial Intelligence in Education: A Focus on Articles Published in International Journal of Artificial Intelligence in Education

abstract.#text: This study employed keyword network analysis to examine research trends in the field of Artificial Intelligence in Education by analyzing author keywords from articles published in International Journal of Artificial Intelligence in Education. To achieve research objectives, author keywords were collected from all eligible articles published in the journal and organized into an analyzable dataset through preprocessing procedures. Results of data analysis are summarized as follows. First, the keyword frequency analysis revealed that artificial intelligence, natural language processing, and machine learning exhibited the highest occurrence frequencies. Second, the keyword network analysis identified three major clusters: NLP- and ML-based automated assessment, feedback, and intelligent tutoring cluster; AI implementation in educational contexts with learning analytics and ethics cluster; and generative AI-driven instructional innovation and AI literacy-curriculum cluster. These findings indicate that AIED research has expanded beyond technology-centered applications toward broader considerations encompassing educational systems, ethical issues, and curriculum innovation.

article-title.#text: Exploring the Integration of Generative AI in Modern Writing Pedagogy: Trends and Implications for Education
현대 글쓰기 교육에서 생성형 인공지능의 통합 탐구: 교육에의 함의와 동향
Exploring the Integration of Generative AI in Modern Writing Pedagogy: Trends and Implications for Education

author: Sheila Noonen(IT Integration Liaison at the International School of Los Angeles)

author.#text: 백조은(Special Appointment Professor at Hanyang Cyber University)

abstract.#text: This annotated bibliographical study investigates current research on writing pedagogy and advancements and responses to the introduction of large language model artificial intelligence. After screening articles collated from various academic databases, research was synthesized into themes revolving around writing instruction, teacher and institutional reactions to digital writing, and early ideas about including Artificial Intelligence during the writing process in a manner that honors academic integrity. This literature review supports the notion that writing pedagogy must continue to innovate as our working definitions of literacies grow to include competencies decoding media beyond print alone. Teachers and academic institutions need support, training, and guidelines on how to leverage digital communication to best prepare students to navigate contemporary society and thrive. Furthermore, students need to be explicitly taught how to engage with generative AI models like ChatGPT to ensure that they remain critical creators and consumers of media.

article-title.#text: Dynamics of the Gendered Effect of Artificial Intelligence Sex Robots: The New Materialism Perspective
인공지능 섹스 로봇의 젠더화된 효과의 역학: 신유물론적 관점
Dynamics of the Gendered Effect of Artificial Intelligence Sex Robots: The New Materialism Perspective

abstract.#text: The advent of artificial intelligence (AI)-driven sex robots has raised major controversies and ethical questions in recent decades. Considered a new apparatus of sexuality, these sex robots combine two different technological innovations: artificial female robotic bodies and AI. This study examined the gendered effect of and interactions/relationships between AI sex robots and humans from the perspective of new materialism, which considers both humans and AI sex robots as “machines” in that they can articulate and mutually interact in a dynamic “assemblage.” The study analyzed how AI sex robots affect perceptions of sexuality and sexual behavior, their interactions with humans, and other associated issues, such as the transformations of the relationships between men and women in an assemblage. The study further explored the effect of the sex robots’ provocative appearance and detachable body design based on the notion of “affordance.” Overall, the present study mapped and examined the network of sexual interactions and connections through the interaction of the various elements surrounding AI sex robots.

article-title.#text: Law and Economics of Artificial Intelligence: Optimal Liability Rules for Accident Losses Caused by Fully Autonomous Vehicles
인공지능의 법경제학: 완전자율주행차 사고에 대한 최적 책임원칙
Law and Economics of Artificial Intelligence: Optimal Liability Rules for Accident Losses Caused by Fully Autonomous Vehicles

author.#text: 김정유(Department of Economics, Kyung Hee University)

abstract.#text: We examine the optimal liability rule in accidents involving fully autonomous vehicles. In cases where enforcing due activity is not feasible, it is socially optimal to apply the strict liability rule to the human operator determining the activity level and to apply the negligence rule to the manufacturer and the victim who select care levels under contributory or comparative negligence in the unilateral activity case. Under the joint and several liability rule, both the manufacturer and the victim exercise due care, contingent on regulating the manufacturer’s liability share sufficiently high, and the human operator assuming the remaining risks chooses the socially optimal activity level maximizing the social net benefit. Conversely, if due activity enforcement is possible, an alternative liability rule proves optimal. Under this rule, the human operator engages in efficient activity to comply with the activity standard, the manufacturer exercises efficient care to meet the care standard, and the victim assumes residual liability so as to be induced to take efficient care. Notably, this liability rule achieves the social optimum, even in bilateral activity cases where both the human operator and the victim engage in activity. Our results diverge from previous findings suggesting that achieving the social optimum involves using public sanctions, such as paying a fine to the state.

article-title.#text: Modernizing the Legislative Process – Optimization, Digitization, Transparency, Engagement and Artificial Intelligence
입법 과정의 현대화 – 최적화, 디지털화, 투명성, 참여 그리고 인공지능
Modernizing the Legislative Process – Optimization, Digitization, Transparency, Engagement and Artificial Intelligence

author-group.author: Sven T. Siefken(Federal University of Applied Administrative Sciences)

abstract.#text: For successful modernization of the legislative process a bird-eye perspective is required, combining theoretical approaches from parliamentary studies with those from public policy research. Starting with problem formulation and political campaigning, continuing through government formation, strategic management and bill drafting to the parliamentary phases. Applying such a wide frame helps to identify challenges in the modernization of legislation in a comparative perspective. Discussing the goals of modernization and presenting approaches to it can only be successful if the inherent tension between conflicting goals is taken into account. Laying out these fundamental challenges, the article helps to set the foundations for successful reform approaches.

article-title.#text: Reframing Research Ethics in the Age of Generative Artificial Intelligence: Key Issues and Practical Proposals
생성형 인공지능 시대의 연구윤리 재정립: 주요 쟁점과 실천적 제언
Reframing Research Ethics in the Age of Generative Artificial Intelligence: Key Issues and Practical Proposals

abstract.#text:
This article explores how the traditional framework of research ethics must be redefined in responseto the ethical challenges posed by the academic use of generative artificial intelligence (Gen AI).
As Gen AI technologies become increasingly integrated across various stages of research—fromstudy design and data analysis to manuscript writing—they offer notable gains in efficiency, whilesimultaneously expanding ethical gray areas. In particular, issues such as factual inaccuracies andhallucinations, violations of privacy and copyright, ambiguous authorship, and the deskilling ofresearchers are becoming increasingly entangled, posing serious threats to the credibility andintegrity of academic work. To address these concerns, the article proposes four core ethicalprinciples suited to the Gen AI era: truthfulness and explainability, respect for intellectual property,field-specific guidelines, and the cultivation of researcher competence. The central concern is notmerely whether such technologies should be adopted, but rather how the identity and responsibilityof researchers, and the sustainability of scholarly communities, can be ethically restructured in theface of transformative technological change.

기술-공학 수업에서 인공지능형 플랫코 코딩 플랫폼의 활용 방안 탐색
Exploring the Use of AI-based FlatCo Coding Platform in Technology and Engineering Classes

abstract.#text:
The purpose of this study is to propose the use of the AI-powered FlatCo coding platform in technology and engineering education in primary and secondary schools.
This study uses a literature review as the main research method to critically examine the feasibility of using AI-based FlatCo coding platforms by topic and to derive educational applications based on this.
The conclusions of this study are as follows; First, FlatCo can be used in primary school technology and engineering classes to introduce basic coding and AI concepts by programming robot control through block-based coding. Second, middle schools can use the FlatCo platform for intermediate robotics projects that include basic AI concepts without overwhelming students with advanced programming. Third, in high school technology and engineering classes, the FlatCo platform can be used for advanced robotics projects that focus on real-world AI applications but do not address the complexities of machine learning. Finally, the FlatCo platform enables increased student engagement and interaction. The FlatCo platform significantly enhances student engagement and hands-on learning by providing real-time.

article-title.#text: The Buddha’s Avyākata and AI Pattern Recognition: Two Upāyas for Disclosing the Emptiness of Language
붓다의 무기(無記)와 인공지능의 패턴인식: 언어의 공성(空性)을 드러내는 두 가지 방편
The Buddha’s Avyākata and AI Pattern Recognition: Two Upāyas for Disclosing the Emptiness of Language

abstract.#text:
Language is generally understood as a vessel that contains meaning. From a Buddhist perspective, however, this vessel is merely an expedient means (Skt. upāya) and cannot transmit object as they truly are. The Buddha’s “unanswered” questions (avyākata, Skt. avyākṛta) deliberately interrupt the patterns carried by language, thereby disclosing that language is not the essence of “reality.” This study analyzes Buddhist insight into the limitations of language through the Buddha’s avyākata. The Buddha’s silence in response to metaphysical questions is interpreted not as a refusal to answer, but as an epistemological act that transcends the structure of language. The study seeks to present the emptiness (suññatā, Skt. śūnyatā) of language thus disclosed not as an abstract concept but as a formally visualized structure. To this end, it employs a simplified Word2Vec model, based on principles of AI pattern recognition, as a formal conceptual simulation. By quantifying patterns of word co-occurrence within selected Buddhist texts, the study diagrammatically demonstrates that meaning is constituted not as a self-subsisting essence but as an interdependent relation (paṭiccasamuppāda).
Ultimately, avyākata is not a negation of language but a non-linguistic expedient means that reveals the emptiness of linguistic representation through action, while Word2Vec functions as a non-linguistic expedient means that formally demonstrates the structure of that emptiness in informational space. In this way, the study proposes a methodological expansion in Buddhist studies through the use of formalized models for conceptual clarification.

언어는 일반적으로 의미를 담는 그릇으로 이해된다. 그러나 불교적 관점에서 이 그릇은 사물을 있는 그대로 전달하지 못하는 방편(方便, upāya)에 불과하다. 붓다의 무기(無記, avyākata, Skt. avyākṛta)는 이렇게 언어로 전달되는 패턴을 의도적으로 중단함으로써, 언어가 ‘실재’의 본질이 아님을 드러낸다.
본 연구는 붓다의 무기를 통해 언어의 한계에 대한 불교적 통찰을 분석 한다. 형이상학 질문에 대한 붓다의 침묵은 답변의 거부가 아니라, 언어의 구조를 초월하는 인식론적 행위로 해석된다. 본 연구는 이렇게 드러나는 언어의 공성(空性)을 추상 개념이 아닌 가시화된 형식으로 제시하고자 한다. 이를 위해 AI 패턴 인식 원리에 기반한 단순화된 Word2Vec 모델을 형식적 개념 시뮬레이션으로 활용한다. 선정된 불교 텍스트 내에서 단어의 동시 출현 패턴을 정량화함으로써, 의미가 자존적(自存的) 본질이 아니라 상호 의존적 관계(paṭiccasamuppāda)로서 구성됨을 도식으로 제시한다.
결국 무기는 언어의 부정이 아니라 언어 표상의 공성을 행동으로 드러내는 비언어적 방편이며, Word2Vec은 그 공성의 구조를 정보 공간에서 시연 형식으로 드러내는 비언어적 방편이다. 이 형식화된 모델의 활용을 통해 개념의 명료화를 추구하는 불교학의 방법론적 확장을 제안한다.

article-title.#text: Endoscopic Ultrasound-Based Artificial Intelligence Diagnosis of Pancreatic Cystic Neoplasms
초음파내시경 기반 인공지능을 이용한 췌장 낭성질환의 진단과 치료
Endoscopic Ultrasound-Based Artificial Intelligence Diagnosis of Pancreatic Cystic Neoplasms

abstract.#text: Pancreatic cystic neoplasms (PCNs) are precursors of pancreatic cancer, and the rate of their incidental detection has gradually increased recently with a reported prevalence from 2.4 to 13.5%. However, accurate diagnosis can be challenging because PCNs have morphologies ranging from benign to malignant disease, and as for other cancers, precise and timely management of premalignant PCN is essential to prevent malignant transformation. Endoscopic ultrasound (EUS) is a useful tool for the differential diagnosis PCN and treatment decision-making because its imaging features predict malignant transformation. However, its performance is suboptimal, and its accuracy for differentiating mucinous pancreatic cysts and other PCNs is only 65-75%, which has increased interest in the application of artificial intelligence (AI). AI has already provided tools that have improved diagnostic accuracies for many cancers, including colon, lung, and breast cancer, and recent studies have shown AI has the potential to differentiate mucinous and non-mucinous tumors and stratify the malignant potentials of PCNs. This article provides a review of the literature on EUS-based AI studies of PCNs.

article-title.#text: Effect of Masking Dental Region on Determining Osteoporosis of Artificial Intelligence on Panoramic Radiographs
인공지능의 파노라마방사선영상에서 골다공증 판정에 미치는 치아영역 마스킹의 효과
Effect of Masking Dental Region on Determining Osteoporosis of Artificial Intelligence on Panoramic Radiographs

abstract.#text:
This study aimed to investigate which areas AI is sensitive when inputting panoramic radiographs with dental area masked and when inputting unmasked ones. Therefore, the null hypothesis of this study was that masking dental area would not make a difference in the sensitive areas of osteoporosis determination of AI. For this study 1165 female(average age 48.4 ± 23.9 years) from whom panoramic radiographs were taken were selected. Either osteoporosis or normal should be clearly defined by oral and maxillofacial radiologists. The panoramic radiographs from the female were classified as either osteoporosis or normal according to the mandibular inferior cortex shape.
VGG-16 model was used to get training, validating, and testing to determine between osteoporosis or normal. Two experiments were performed; one using unmasked images of panoramic radiographs, and the other using panoramic radiographs with dental region masked. In two experiments, accuracy of VGG-16 was 97.9% with unmasked images and 98.6% with dental-region-masked images. In the osteoporosis group, the sensitive areas identified with unmasked images included cervical vertebrae, maxillary and mandibular cancellous bone, dental area, zygomatic bone, mandibular inferior cortex, and cranial base. The osteoporosis group shows sensitivity on mandibular cancellous bone, cervical vertebrae, and mandibular inferior cortex with masked images. In the normal group, when unmasked images were input, only dental region was sensitive, while with masked images, only mandibular cancellous bone was sensitive. It is suggestive that when dental influence of panoramic radiographs was excluded, AI determined osteoporosis on the mandibular cancellous bone more sensitively.

article-title.#text: A Study on the Impact of Generative Artificial Intelligence on Creative Convergence Problem Solving
생성형 인공지능이 창의 융복합적 문제해결에 미치는 영향에 관한 연구
A Study on the Impact of Generative Artificial Intelligence on Creative Convergence Problem Solving

abstract.#text: The objective of this study is to examine the factors that shape problem-solving processes through the lens of generative artificial intelligence (AI) and to develop an educational model that integrates generative AI into the problem-solving process. To facilitate analysis, we divided the problem-solving process into three stages: understanding the problem, designing the solution, and selecting the best solution. Subsequently, we aligned each stage with the nine core elements of computational thinking to develop the educational framework. Following the development of a generative AI-based software engineering course based on the design, a correlation analysis was conducted on the necessity of generative AI in the problem-solving process. This analysis was performed after providing 218 learners of humanities and social sciences with a 16-week basic software engineering education. The results of the hierarchical regression analysis demonstrated that generative AI exerted an influence when data were analyzed during the problem understanding stage (t-value = 8.85, R Square = 0.712). In the design stage of the problem-solving process, generative AI had a significant impact on the algorithms and procedures step (t-value = 13.810, R Square = 0.713). In the selection of the optimal solution, generative AI was found to exert a considerable influence in the automation stage (t-value = 7.764, R Square = 0.691). In light of these findings, it was concluded that the integration of generative AI into the stages of data analysis, algorithms and procedures, and automation in the educational curriculum could enhance learners' problem-solving abilities. It is our contention that this research will facilitate future research on learning guidelines for generative AI.

article-title.#text: Ambiguous AI: Lossy Compression, Model Collapse, and Intercultural Sensitivity
인공지능과 모호성: 손실 압축, 모델 붕괴, 그리고 문화 간 민감성
Ambiguous AI: Lossy Compression, Model Collapse, and Intercultural Sensitivity

abstract.#text: This paper examines the intersections of artificial intelligence (AI), cultural representation, and intercultural sensitivity, critiquing the impact of lossy compression and model collapse on cultural expression in AI systems. The study introduces “intentional patiency” as an alternative framework, conceptualizing AI not merely as an active agent but as a cultural receptor, and in turn, producer. AI systems often rely on compression algorithms that strip away cultural complexities, rendering nuanced traditions as simplified, stereotypical artifacts. Drawing on frameworks from Ted Chiang’s metaphor of lossy compression to Wendy Chun’s critique of noise, the essay explores how AI’s data optimization selectively filters cultural diversity, perpetuating dominant narratives while silencing marginalized voices. Model collapse in generative systems demonstrates while also exacertabting the pitfalls of homogenous data to reduce cultural representations to monolithic “single stories,” echoing concerns raised by Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie. To address this issue, this essay advocates for an interculturally sensitive AI development paradigm, incorporating cultural expansion and ethical safeguards to mitigate cultural erasure. Through the concept of “ambiguous AI,” a paradigm rooted in probabilistic engagement and intentional patiency, the essay seeks to reframe AI’s role as a nuanced participant in cultural discourse, promoting culturally adaptive architectures.

article-title.#text: A needs analysis of AI textbooks for Guangzhou primary and middle schools from a student perspective
학생 관점에서 중국 광저우 초·중등 인공지능 교과서에 대한 요구 분석
A needs analysis of AI textbooks for Guangzhou primary and middle schools from a student perspective

abstract.#text:
[Purpose] This study aims to identify the needs for AI textbooks in Guangzhou’s primary and middle schools from students’ perspectives and to suggest priorities and directions for textbook design.
[Method] In November 2024, an online survey of 462 students was conducted. After reliability and validity checks, we applied an importance–performance t-test, Borich needs assessment, and Locus for Focus analysis.
[Results] From students’ perspectives, AI textbooks in Guangzhou generally meet or even exceed their expectations in several respects. These textbooks receive relatively high evaluations for adherence to language norms and the explanation of concepts. However, in certain aspects, such as content integration and coherence, students have not yet perceived clear improvements.
[Conclusion] To achieve student-centered textbook design, we recommend prioritizing consistent topic-unit structures, learner-friendly language and expressions, and stronger inclusion and digital learning support. We also call for differentiated designs that reflect differences by school level and experience with AI classes.

article-title.#text: Digital Trade Agreements as Platforms for AI Cooperation: A Case Study of Singapore's Strategic Approach
싱가포르의 디지털 통상정책과 국제기술협력 사례 분석: 인공지능(AI) 분야를 중심으로
Digital Trade Agreements as Platforms for AI Cooperation: A Case Study of Singapore's Strategic Approach

abstract.#text:
Purpose : This study analyzes Singapore's digital trade policies and international technology cooperation in the artificial intelligence (AI) sector to derive practical implications for South Korea's digital trade policy. Singapore has been building a systematic AI governance framework through the Digital Economy Partnership Agreement (DEPA) and bilateral digital trade agreements with Australia, the UK, South Korea, and the EU to establish itself as a global AI hub.




Research design, data, methodology : This paper analyzes AI-related provisions across Singapore's digital trade agreements, examining their differentiated approaches and common principles. It compares key elements of bilateral agreements with DEPA, focusing on how these agreements incorporate internationally recognized principles such as explainability, transparency, fairness, and human-centric values. The study develops an "Agreement-Policy-Implementation" linkage analysis framework to systematically evaluate the effectiveness of digital trade agreements.




Results : According to the analysis, ASDEA emphasizes concrete cooperation measures, UKSDEA focuses on technical elements such as algorithmic transparency, and EUSDEA highlights interoperability of AI governance systems, demonstrating differentiated approaches across agreements. All agreements incorporate internationally recognized principles including explainability, transparency, fairness, and human-centric values.




Conclusions : This study introduces a new analytical framework for evaluating the effectiveness of digital trade agreements and recommends that South Korea develop tailored cooperation strategies reflecting its own digital ecosystem. For AI cooperation between Singapore and South Korea to move beyond declarative commitments, both countries must build a sustainable international collaboration framework that enhances social responsibility alongside technological innovation.

article-title.#text: Review of Empirical Research on Artificial Intelligence in Public Administration: Effects, Adoption, and Evidence-Informed Recommendations
공공행정에서의 인공지능 활용에 관한 실증 연구: 공공 AI를 위한 정책적 시사점
Review of Empirical Research on Artificial Intelligence in Public Administration: Effects, Adoption, and Evidence-Informed Recommendations

abstract.#text: With artificial intelligence (AI) technologies becoming increasingly integrated into government operations, public administration faces both new opportunities and challenges in managing public service delivery. This review synthesizes findings from over 25 peer-reviewed empirical studies published between 2009 and 2025, focusing exclusively on research that examines the real-world adoption and impact of AI in the public sector. Specifically, this review evaluates research using quantitative analyses and mixed-methods designs across diverse policy domains and national contexts. This paper organizes the literature around two key perspectives — citizens and government officials — to examine how AI affects citizens’ perceptions of fairness, trust, and accountability, as well as how it alters street-level public officials’ discretion, professional norms, and implementation methods. The results show the potential benefits of AI , such as improved efficiency and service accessibility, as well as its limitations including automation bias, perceived loss of control, and worsening of inequality. Drawing on these empirical findings, this review concludes with practical recommendations for public officials and policy-makers to encourage the ethical, equitable and context-sensitive adoption of AI in government.

article-title.#text: Discourse on Philosophy of Technology in the Era of Artificial Intelligence - Focusing on humanities, engineering, and integrated perspectives-
인공지능 시대의 기술철학 담론 - 인문학적, 공학적, 통합적 관점을 중심으로 -
Discourse on Philosophy of Technology in the Era of Artificial Intelligence - Focusing on humanities, engineering, and integrated perspectives-

abstract.#text: This study aimed to explore the philosophy of technology with a focus on AI, considering perspectives from engineering and the humanities and their integration in this AI ​​era. The main research questions were: How does engineering philosophy view the development and potential of AI? How does the humanistic philosophy critically evaluate the impact of AI on human life? What insights can be gained by integrating these perspectives? The study’s conclusions are as follows: First, engineering technology philosophy takes an optimistic view of AI development, emphasizing technological advancement and future potential. Engineers prioritize innovation, efficiency, and the functionality of AI systems, envisioning transformative impacts across various domains, including healthcare, transportation, and education. Second, the humanistic philosophy takes a critical and reflective approach, evaluating AI’s impact on human life and society. This perspective highlights concerns related to ethics, bias, autonomy, and social justice. Third, a comprehensive understanding of AI can be achieved by integrating engineering and humanities perspectives. This integration enables the development of AI technologies that are not only technologically robust but also ethically sound and socially responsible. Such integration fosters human-centered AI systems that augment human capabilities while preserving autonomy and dignity. Future research suggestions include: from an engineering perspective, exploring ethical considerations in the design and implementation of AI algorithms; from a humanistic perspective, examining AI’s impact on human identity and society; and from an integrated perspective, conducting longitudinal research evaluating AI’s long-term societal impact.

article-title.#text: Clinical Applicability of Artificial Intelligence-based Early Detection and Prognosis Assessment in Pancreatic Cancer
인공지능을 활용한 췌장암의 조기 발견 및 예후 평가의 임상 적용 가능성
Clinical Applicability of Artificial Intelligence-based Early Detection and Prognosis Assessment in Pancreatic Cancer

author.#text: 김영중(Department of Internal Medicine, Hallym University Hangang Sacred Heart Hospital, Seoul, Korea)

abstract.#text:
Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is a highly lethal malignancy with poor survivalrates, primarily due to its late-stage diagnosis. Early detection is crucial for improving patientoutcomes. The present review summarized the recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI)for the early detection and prognosis of PDAC. This review synthesized studies on the applicationsof AI that were conducted over a 5-year period (2020–2025). These applications includemachine learning models analyzing radiomic features from computed tomography (CT) scans,automated analysis of circulating microRNA (miRNA) profiles, and personalized circulatingtumor DNA (ctDNA) assays for monitoring molecular residual disease. AI-driven radiomicsidentified PDAC on CT scans with high accuracy at a median of 398 days before clinical diagnosis.
A diagnostic model combining miRNA and cancer antigen 19-9 demonstrated excellentperformance (area under the curve value, 0.99), even in early-stage asymptomatic patients.
Post-operative ctDNA positivity was strongly associated with shorter disease-free survival (hazardratio, 5.45) and higher recurrence rates. AI-based analyses of CT scans, miRNA, and ctDNAhold promise for the early diagnosis and risk stratification of PDAC. The present review summarized the recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI)for the early detection and prognosis of PDAC. This review synthesized studies on the applicationsof AI that were conducted over a 5-year period (2020–2025). article-title.#text: The Impact of Generative AI Platform Characteristics on User Trust and Usage Intention
생성형 인공지능 플랫폼 특성이 사용자 신뢰도 및 사용 의도에 미치는 영향
The Impact of Generative AI Platform Characteristics on User Trust and Usage Intention

abstract.#text: This study empirically analyzed how key characteristics of generative AI platforms influence user trust and usage intention. In particular, it focused on three platform characteristics: informativeness, security, and convenience and investigated whether they directly affect user trust and whether trust plays a mediating role in the relationship between platform characteristics and usage intention. To this end, the study collected 274 valid responses from an online survey targeting users of generative AI platforms in China, and employed correlation, regression, and mediation analyses to test the proposed relationships. Results reveal that informativeness and convenience significantly enhance user trust, which in turn positively affects usage intention. These findings underscore trust as a critical mechanism linking platform attributes to user behavior. The study offers practical implications for platform developers and marketers, emphasizing the importance of user-centered information, improved usability, and trust-building strategies. It also calls for further research into user perceptions of security and individual differences in trust formation.

article-title.#text: Research on China's AI Strategic Spatial Layout from a Regional Differentiation Perspective

Research on China's AI Strategic Spatial Layout from a Regional Differentiation Perspective

abstract.#text: Against intensifying global AI competition and stark regional disparities in China, this study addresses AI industry growth imbalance via 2018–2023 panel data of 31 provinces. Integrating a “economic foundation-innovation input-industrial ecology” framework with a spatial-institutional heterogeneity perspective, it explores AI strategic layout’s driving mechanisms and regional paths. Key findings: AI fixed-asset investment dominates; per capita GDP has an ¥80,000 threshold effect reducible by institutional innovation; R&D shows an S-shaped regional response; high-tech enterprises realize full mediation via digital employment. Eastern, central and western China form distinct development modes. This study reconstructs the theoretical framework and offers empirical support for targeted AI development policies.

article-title.#text: An Educational Approach to Real-Time Anomaly Detection Using an Edge AI System for Urban Mobility Safety

An Educational Approach to Real-Time Anomaly Detection Using an Edge AI System for Urban Mobility Safety

abstract.#text: The rapid expansion of personal mobility devices, such as electric kickboards, has raised new safety concerns in urban environ-ments, particularly for mobility-impaired individuals. This study proposes an edge AI-based object recognition system as an educa-tional and practical approach to addressing these challenges. The system employs the YOLOv5 architecture to detect and classify electric kickboards, standing individuals, and fallen individuals in real time, demonstrating the application of artificial intelligence to real-world safety problems. Deployed on an NVIDIA Jetson platform, the system enables low-latency, network-independent inference and features a modular design that allows flexible integration with various mobility platforms. Experimental results show that the proposed approach achieves a balanced performance between detection accuracy and computational efficiency. This study highlights the potential of edge AI technologies not only for improving urban safety but also as an effective instructional resource for AI literacy, problem-based learning, and interdisciplinary education.

article-title.#text: Vers une obsolescence de l’enseignant humain à l’ère de l’intelligence artificielle? Perspectives rousseauistes sur l’éducation
인공지능시대 실제 교사의 존재가치가 유의미한 것인가? 루소의 교육관에 의거한 견해
Vers une obsolescence de l’enseignant humain à l’ère de l’intelligence artificielle? Perspectives rousseauistes sur l’éducation

abstract.#text:
Cet article interroge l’hypothèse d’une intelligence artificielle qui remplacerait le professeur. Pour y répondre, il s’appuie sur le traité de philosophie de l’éducation   Emile, ou De l’éducation   (1762) de Jean-Jacques Rousseau.
La première partie présente brièvement le déploiement de l’intelligence artificielle aux différents échelons scolaires puis énumère plusieurs aspects positifs de son usage pour les étudiants, notamment le renouvellement de la relation entre l’étudiant et l’objet de son étude, en particulier la personnalisation qu’elle permet. Néanmoins, il importe de ne pas négliger les aspects négatifs de l’intelligence artificielle : au-delà de ses limites propres (risques d’hallucinations, erreurs), l’IA peut conduire l’étudiant vers une forme de dépendance, fragiliser la relation de confiance avec le professeur, accroître sa démotivation, appauvrir son lien à la matière enseignée, démontrer des limites éthiques (par exemple, gestion des données personnelles) et contribuer à une dévalorisation implicite du métier de professeur.
Dans une deuxième partie, la réflexion rousseauiste concernant la bonne éducation est analysée à travers plusieurs axes : la finalité morale et politique de l’enseignement, la question de l’efficacité de l’enseignement (ancrage dans la pratique), l’étayage social (social scaffolding), la volonté de développer chez l’élève son identité propre. Or, des limites notables apparaissent lorsque ces éléments sont confrontés à un enseignement assuré exclusivement par une intelligence artificielle.
La troisième partie montre, toujours à partie de Rousseau, d’autres insuffisances majeures de l’hypothèse d’une intelligence artificielle remplaçant le professeur : il est rappelé que l’enseignement n’est pas une simple transaction utilitariste de connaissances mais qu’il repose aussi sur une relation humaine, qui accorde une place centrale aux émotions, prend en compte la singularité d’autrui et mobilise des dimensions relevant de la psychologie profonde. Au-delà de ces éléments, il apparaît également que le mimétisme humain joue un rôle important dans tout échange et que l’intelligence artificielle, en dépit de toutes ses qualités et de ses efforts à simuler un échange humain, ne satisfait à cette exigence que partiellement : elle ne peut offrir qu’un simulacre de relation.
En définitive, l’analyse conduit à considérer l’intelligence artificielle comme un complément pertinent au rôle de professeur, et non comme un substitut.

article-title.#text: Comparative Analysis of Midjourney, Stable Diffusion and Krea: A Case Study on Storyboard Development with Artificial Intelligence
Midjourney, Stable Diffusion 및 Krea의 비교 분석: 인공지능을 활용한 스토리보드 개발 사례 연구
Comparative Analysis of Midjourney, Stable Diffusion and Krea: A Case Study on Storyboard Development with Artificial Intelligence

author.#text: 부이두엉화이린(Department of Digital Media, Soongsil University)
이강희(Department of Digital Media, Soongsil University)

abstract.#text: The landscape of artificial intelligence (AI) has witnessed a rapid and remarkable evolution, particularly within artistic applications. The integration of AI in artistic endeavors has been a longstanding practice. However, it attained widespread recognition with user-friendly workflows exemplified by Midjourney, DALL-E, and Stable Diffusion. The transformative capabilities of AI have empowered individuals to expeditiously generate artistic paintings, marking a paradigm shift in the temporal dynamics of artistic production. Consequently, this study undertakes a comprehensive comparative analysis of Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, and Krea within the context of storyboard development in animation pre-production. The primary focus centers on elucidating effective methodologies for leveraging these generators in storyboard creation. The analytical framework scrutinizes their distinctive approaches, output quality, user-friendliness, and overall impact on workflow dynamics. Crucially, the findings of this study underscore that these generators, while collectively enhancing efficiency and creative possibilities in storyboard development, each proffers unique advantages: Midjourney excels in the realms of artistic quality and visual allure, Stable Diffusion demonstrates superiority in user control and customization, while Krea distinguishes itself with its noteworthy real-time AI image generation capabilities.

article-title.#text: Artificial Intelligence for Thyroid Ultrasound: Clinical Performance, Pitfalls, and Practice Integration
갑상선초음파에서 인공지능: 임상적 성과, 잠재적 한계, 및 임상 실무 통합
Artificial Intelligence for Thyroid Ultrasound: Clinical Performance, Pitfalls, and Practice Integration

abstract.#text: The use of artificial intelligence (AI) in thyroid ultrasound is bringing important changes to endocrine imaging, helping improve diagnostic accuracy and make the assessment of thyroid nodules more consistent. This review examines the current applications, technological approaches, clinical performance, adversities, and future directions of AI-based systems in thyroid ultrasound. Recent studies suggest that AI technologies hold significant potential in thyroid ultrasound, particularly in automated nodule detection, classification, and risk stratification. Deep learning models, particularly convolutional neural networks, achieve diagnostic accuracies exceeding 90% in distinguishing benign from malignant nodules, often matching or surpassing human radiologist performance. Current applications include Thyroid Imaging Reporting and Data System-based classification systems, lymph node metastasis prediction, and real-time diagnostic assistance. However, challenges including reproducibility concerns, clinical workflow integration, and regulatory considerations remain significant barriers to widespread adoption. While AI shows remarkable promise in thyroid ultrasound applications, challenges including validation requirements, standardization needs, and clinical integration barriers must be addressed for widespread adoption. Future developments should focus on multimodal integration, explainable AI systems, and prospective clinical trials to fully utilize the potential of AI in transforming thyroid diagnostics.

article-title.#text: Evaluating the Accuracy of Artificial Intelligence-Based Chatbots on Pediatric Dentistry Questions in the Korean National Dental Board Exam
치과의사 국가시험 소아치과 문제에 대한 인공지능 기반 챗봇의 정확성 평가
Evaluating the Accuracy of Artificial Intelligence-Based Chatbots on Pediatric Dentistry Questions in the Korean National Dental Board Exam

abstract.#text:
This study aimed to assess the competency of artificial intelligence (AI) in pediatric dentistry and compare it with that of dentists. We used open-source data obtained from the Korea Health Personnel Licensing Examination Institute. A total of 32 item multiple-choice pediatric dentistry exam questions were included. Two AIbased chatbots (ChatGPT 3.5 and Gemini) were evaluated. Each chatbot received the same questions seven times in separate chat sessions initiated on April 25, 2024.
The accuracy was assessed by measuring the percentage of correct answers, and consistency was evaluated using Cronbach’s alpha coefficient. Both ChatGPT 3.5 and Gemini demonstrated similar accuracy, with no significant differences observed between them. However, neither chatbot achieved the minimum passing score set by the Pediatric Dentistry National Examination. However, both chatbots exhibited acceptable consistency in their responses. Within the limits of this study, both AIbased chatbots did not sufficiently answer the pediatric dentistry exam questions.
This finding suggests that pediatric dentists should be aware of the advantages and limitations of this new tool and effectively utilize it to promote patient health.

article-title.#text: Feasibility of Using an AI System for Breast Ultrasonography Interpretation According to Clinical Expertise: Results of a Pilot Study
임상 경력에 따른 유방 초음파 인공지능 판독 시스템의 활용 효과를 보기 위한 파일럿 연구
Feasibility of Using an AI System for Breast Ultrasonography Interpretation According to Clinical Expertise: Results of a Pilot Study

abstract.#text:
Purpose To evaluate the benefits of using a commercially available AI system for breast ultrasonography (US) among readers with varying levels of expertise.
Materials and Methods A total of 285 breast lesions from 141 women who underwent breast US between February 2012 and April 2015 were retrospectively analyzed using a deep-learning-based AI system for lesion detection and diagnosis. Five readers, comprising experienced (two breast radiologists and one breast surgeon) and inexperienced (one gynecologist and one radiology resident) groups, reviewed the grayscale US images in two sessions: without AI assistance (session 1) and with AI assistance after a two-week washout period (session 2). Diagnostic performance was compared between sessions.
Results The mean area under the curve for all readers significantly improved with AI, increasing from 0.885 to 0.927 (p < 0.001). The inexperienced group demonstrated significant improvements in mean sensitivity (56.9%–87.5%, p < 0.001), negative predictive value (NPV) (77.9%–90.1%, p < 0.001), and accuracy (76.1%–84.4%, p = 0.005). However, no significant improvements were observed for the experienced readers (all p-values > 0.05).
Conclusion The AI system for breast US significantly enhanced the diagnostic performance of inexperienced readers, augmenting sensitivity, NPV, and accuracy, while experienced readers demonstrated minimal improvement, likely due to their already high baseline performance.

article-title.#text: Development of an AI based Smart Beehive Platform and Its Innovative Application to Apiculture System Transformation
인공지능 기반 스마트 벌통 통합 플랫폼 개발과 혁신적 양봉 시스템 전환 사례
Development of an AI based Smart Beehive Platform and Its Innovative Application to Apiculture System Transformation

abstract.#text: Honeybees are essential pollinators for agricultural crops, but their recent population decline threatens global food security. In response to this decline in honeybee populations, this study presents the development and field validation of the Smart Beehive System, which integrates artificial intelligence (AI) and Internet of Things (IoT) technologies. The system features a three−tier architecture combining real−time video analysis counters with environmental sensor monitoring. Under laboratory conditions, the DeepSORT algorithm- based AI bee counter achieved 97.5% accuracy, and its capability to detect swarming events in real−world conditions was examined through pilot operations across 26 farms. Analysis of 13−day data from eight hives revealed statistically significant increases in net outflow during two swarming events (p < 0.05) with very large effect sizes (Cohen's d > 1.7). The OUT ratio during swarming periods (55–56%) was consistent with biological expectations (~50%), while IoT sensor data showed strong correlations (r > 0.92) with meteorological datasets, suggesting measurement reliability. The proposed system enables remote monitoring, early warning, and data−driven decision−making, supporting the digital transformation of the apiculture industry. It aligns with the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) 2, 12, and 15, and is expected to serve as a data foundation for developing predictive models of swarming behavior.

article-title.#text: Integrating Generative AI into Chatbot UI Design Processes: A Workflow Using ChatGPT and Midjourney
생성형 인공지능 기반 챗봇 UI 디자인 워크플로우: ChatGPT와 Midjourney의 통합 활용
Integrating Generative AI into Chatbot UI Design Processes: A Workflow Using ChatGPT and Midjourney

abstract.#text: This study proposes a generative AI–assisted workflow for early-stage chatbot user interface (UI) design. While chatbot persona and visual form significantly influence user trust, emotional engagement, and service perception, they are often addressed only after core functionality is implemented, leading to misalignment between visual expression and interaction goals. To address this gap, eighty real-world chatbots across six industry sectors were analyzed to construct an evidence-based framework—the Visual Taxonomy Matrix (VTM)(Figure 1)—that maps relationships among visual form, emotional tone, and service purpose. Building on these insights, a five-stage workflow integrating ChatGPT for textual persona ideation and Midjourney for visual exploration was developed. The workflow was applied in a first-year “Introduction to Computer Graphics” course through the HanseoBot project, improving students’ creative confidence and design comprehension. Although limited to a single case, the study demonstrates how generative AI can enhance multimodal ideation and process efficiency in early design stages, offering both educational and practical implications.

article-title.#text: A Study on Smart Construction Site Management Systems based on Artificial Intelligence to Prevent Serious Accidents in Small and Medium-sized Enterprises
중소기업 건설현장 중대재해 예방을 위한 인공지능 기반 스마트 현장관리시스템
A Study on Smart Construction Site Management Systems based on Artificial Intelligence to Prevent Serious Accidents in Small and Medium-sized Enterprises

abstract.#text: The recent expansion of the Serious Accidents Punishment Act (SAPA) has made it increasingly urgent for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to adopt effective safety management practices. Despite this need, many SMEs lack practical solutions tailored to their limited resources. This study proposes the Smart Site Management System (SSMS), which is designed to strengthen safety management through the use of smart technologies on SME-operated construction sites. The SSMS collects and analyzes real-time data to support AI-generated customized surveys, and the personalized Toolbox Meeting (TBM) enables early identification of high-risk tasks and potential hazards. By facilitating timely interventions, the system helps prevent serious accidents before they occur. The SSMS comprises essential components including sensors, data acquisition devices, monitoring and analysis tools, TBM automation, and safety alert mechanisms. To address the operational constraints of SMEs, the system incorporates resource-efficient solutions such as the Horizontal Pod Autoscaler and AI-driven prediction models. This research highlights the growing legal responsibilities of SMEs under the SAPA, and explores how smart technologies can support proactive compliance. Ultimately, the proposed system should enable SMEs to achieve safety management standards comparable to those of large construction firms.

To address the operational constraints of SMEs, the system incorporates resource-efficient solutions such as the Horizontal Pod Autoscaler and AI-driven prediction models. This research highlights the growing legal responsibilities of SMEs under the SAPA, and explores how smart technologies can support proactive compliance. Ultimately, the proposed system should enable SMEs to achieve safety management standards comparable to those of large construction firms.

article-title.#text: Adopting Big Data AI and Robo-Advisor to Investment Strategy : Case of Vanguard
투자 전략에 있어서 빅데이터 인공지능과 로보어드바이저의 도입 : 뱅가드 사례를 중심으로
Adopting Big Data AI and Robo-Advisor to Investment Strategy : Case of Vanguard

author: Ureta Vaquero Ivan(The University of Applied Sciences and Arts of Southern Switzerland)

abstract.#text:
Utilizing artificial intelligence technology through the integration of data and computers is becoming increasingly commonplace in the realm of investment.
Quantitative investing is a strategy that involves quantifying various indicators and utilizing computers and data for investment decisions. Over an extended period, it has demonstrated consistent returns, leading to widespread adoption by various investment firms as its effectiveness has been proven.
This study aims to provide specific directions and insights for asset management companies and other investment professionals as they integrate cutting-edge technologies, including artificial intelligence. To achieve this goal this study conducted an experiential case study aiming to derive context and phenomena. The study focused on Vanguard, the world's largest asset manager with a staggering $7.7 trillion in assets under management. The research investigated the evolution of Vanguard's investment methods, starting from its initial establishment, and traced the adoption of big data-based artificial intelligence technology throughout the process, culminating in the provision of services to clients through robo-advisors. For the framework of this study, the ser-M perspective was used, considering not only the Subject (S), Environment (E), and Resources (R) but also the mechanisms (M) that encompass the organic relationships among them.
Through this approach, the aim was to ensure an unbiased and well-balanced analysis. The main findings of this research are that the founder, Bogle, played a pivotal role in strategic decision-making, demonstrating a keen ability to adapt swiftly and make relevant judgments in an environment shifting towards a data-driven paradigm, including the internalization of technological resources. From a mechanistic perspective, the analysis highlights the crucial establishment of organizational culture as innovation is driven daily in routine tasks, seamlessly permeating throughout the organization

Research on the development of an AI-based customized learning support model: Focusing on the university class environment

abstract.#text:
Research Purpose: Based on artificial intelligence, this study considers learners' characteristics, learning content, and individual learning, and analyzes the collected learning data to develop a model that supports customized learning for individual learners.
Research content and method: In order to achieve the research purpose, the literature was analyzed to investigate the structure of customized learning support, learning data analysis, and learning activities, and based on the investigated data, the area and detailed components of the customized learning support model were derived. did. A draft model was constructed through literature analysis, and the first expert Delphi survey was conducted on the draft model with five experts. The results of this study provide basic data that can be used as a reference for constructing a customized learning support system based on artificial intelligence, taking into account the university's class environment.

Comparison of the cases based on the usage of artificial intelligence in the EdTech industry - Focusing on IBM Watson Talent and Riiid R.Inside

abstract.#text: Attempts to integrate artificial intelligence (AI) into the EdTech industry have been increasing during the COVID-19 pandemic. This study serves as a guide for future studies on designing better AI-enabled adaptive learning systems to resolve specific learning difficulties and improve learning experiences. A case study on IBM and Riiid was conducted to examine the use of AI in the EdTech industry. IBM Watson Talent, which is a set of talent management solutions designed to assist companies to recruit and educate talent throughout their career paths, comprises technologies that analyze cognitive computing, cloud platforms, and diverse learning experiences. Riiid’s proprietary AI technology determines a learner’s skills based on problem-solving data and optimizes the adaptive content to motivate the learner to achieve their goals within a deadline. This study examined the feasibility of AI being used to develop and deliver innovative individualized learning strategies for future company education, specifically the AI-based learning platforms and services being introduced into the EdTech industry. The study identified the key adaptive learning system factors essential for effective AI development and applications.

article-title.#text: The Application of AI in Criminal Justice and the Realization of “Justice of Prediction”: Contemporary Challenges and Opportunities of Legaltech
형사사법에서 인공지능의 적용과 “예측의 정의” 실현 방안: 리걸테크의 현대적 도전과 기회
The Application of AI in Criminal Justice and the Realization of “Justice of Prediction”: Contemporary Challenges and Opportunities of Legaltech

abstract.#text:
Considering the advancement of AI technology and societal interest, it is highly likely that AI systems will be applied in the field of criminal justice as well. This suggests the potential for the utilization of various legaltech and is expected to lead to significant institutional changes. In the legal domain, as various artificial intelligence programs begin to assist with judicial decision-making, the practical definition of criminal justice will ultimately come to be defined by “the Justice of Prediction”. This means that the definition of criminal justice will depend on how sophisticated and accurate the predictive technologies of AI are in their programming and application.
AI will play a central role in enhancing the efficiency and qualitative improvement of legal predictions. This paper aims to review the current state of two areas of legal prediction in our criminal justice system: judicial prediction and crime prediction(in particular, the prediction of recidivism). It also seeks to explore strategies for realizing "predictive justice" within criminal justice and to propose the necessity for legal and institutional improvements, along with specific directions, as the legaltech industry continues to develop.
To achieve this, the paper introduces foreign cases and precedents, while also examining their limitations to proactively highlight considerations that should be taken into account as the legaltech industry develops in Korea. Specifically, the paper aims to present three practical strategies for the future development of legaltech in our country. Furthermore, it seeks to broadly propose institutional and legal improvements that can be applied to Korea by reviewing current issues and relevant foreign examples. First, the paper will propose a strategy based on the analysis of German cases, with a focus on benchmarking these examples. Additionally, it will outline specific strategies for realizing "predictive justice" through the improvement of related laws, as well as strategies for realization through perception change and educational innovation. Ultimately, the concrete implementation of the three strategies presented in this paper is expected to serve as a crucial foundation for ensuring predictive justice in the upcoming legaltech era.
